speaker: Shay
en: So Colonel... It seems my life is an open book to you.

speaker: Monro
en: Men from my regiment found you delirious and half-drowned. I did not know who you were, but WHAT you were was obvious. I brought you to the Finnegans for care. Their late son was one of our Order.

speaker: Weeks
en: Master Johnson was furious!

speaker: Monro
en: It was a risk, but I suspected you might have left your brothers behind.

speaker: Shay
en: Colonel... The Manuscript. Why return it to me?

speaker: Monro
en: Because, Master Cormac, you earned my trust. It could not be in better hands.

speaker: Shay
en: Respectfully, sir... I'm more of a target than you now.

speaker: Weeks
en: Gentlemen? Kesegowaase is rallying to storm Albany. His allies threaten a friendly Oneida village, and French troops have already entered our territory.

speaker: Shay
en: I might be able to delay the French and help the Oneida.

speaker: Monro
en: We will ready the defenses in Albany.

speaker: Shay
en: If we are to defeat Kesegowaase and his allies, I need to help the Oneida... and see what I can do about the French.

speaker: Soldier 1
en: Report, soldier.

speaker: Soldier 2
en: No hostiles in the area, sir.

speaker: Soldier 1
en: Good, don't let your guard down.

speaker: Man 1
en: How much lumber do we have to build defenses?

speaker: Soldier 3
en: Hardly a bean's worth.

speaker: Soldier 4
en: Johnson stockpiled powder and shot here.

speaker: Soldier 5
en: Bless him!

speaker: Gist
en: So, not to pry, but would you happen to know if Kesegowaase has any weaknesses?

speaker: Shay
en: He hasn't any. He was a scout and mercenary long before he joined the Assassins.

speaker: Gist
en: May Lady Luck be with you, then.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck.

speaker: Gist
en: The Colonel exerts a certain amount of control over the army, or part of it anyway. But we'll need both the soldiers and their native allies if we're to set up a proper defense against Kesegowaase.

speaker: Shay
en: Kesegowaase has allies in every tribe that sided with the French, as well as many others: trappers, hunters, scouts... We'll need all the help we can muster.

speaker: Shay
en: Venerable one. My name is Shay Patrick Cormac. I... I am a friend.

speaker: Onatah
en: A friend indeed. You have the gratitude of my people, Shay Patrick Cormac. For as long as you shall walk this earth, you will have a place here, among us.

speaker: Shay
en: My thanks.

speaker: Onatah
en: It is I who thank you, young man. Would you be so kind as to walk with me? I am called Onatah. There is a legend among my people. It tells of how the land under our feet was born, and how good and evil came into this world. The Sky Woman scattered her wisdom throughout our land. If you follow her path, you shall learn the true history of our people... and perhaps even uncover the reward locked within this cave... If you are the hero I believe you to be.

speaker: Shay
en: You honor me, venerable one.

speaker: Onatah
en: It is you who honor us, Shay Patrick Cormac. Farewell.

speaker: Brown
en: Come to join the hunt, my friend? We're not hunting elk today, I'll tell you that much. I'll try to leave some for you!

speaker: Borgen
en: These are difficult times, death is floating around like a fog. I don't have enough supplies to help everyone. The trade routes are too dangerous, few want to travel them. Let's hope to God we can settle down once and for all someday.

speaker: Greear
en: Good sir, you look like you're having a bad day too. My back aches something terrible. I was attacked by a bear and haven't been able to work in months! My stomach is rumbling almost as loudly as that bear did. Now some of my customers are complaining, and... Uh oh!

speaker: Snider
en: These fellows are everywhere, trying to control our lives through violence. My last article exposed them for what they are, my next one will bring them down once and for all!

speaker: Johnson
en: Back in my day, men fought properly, face to face. If these clowns would only stand their ground, none of them could stop me! But, erhm... I can't climb roofs like I used to... Help me out, will you?

speaker: Gurley
en: Those bastards! They sent me dozens of threats saying that the last woman who stood in their way was burned alive, like a witch. They are simply brutes. I have the local governance behind me. I am sure it is just a matter of time before we can rid our town of their filthy corruption!

speaker: Assassin
en: I knew you'd take the bait, "hero"! Get him, brothers!

speaker: Crawley
en: You! It has been a long time since I have seen any living soul around here. Strange, you almost remind me of my former compatriots. I must be imagining things. They might be coming around soon, and I cannot be responsible for your safety if you hang about.

speaker: Beaubien
en: Everyone in this damned town is trying to steal my fishing spot. None of them will stop me today! You! You don't like fishing, do you?

speaker: Plourde
en: Is this not beautiful? This view on the infinite ocean... No need to present yourself, I know who you are. Unfortunately, I will not be sharing the same fate as you...

speaker: Gordon
en: We cannot talk here. It's too risky. Know this: today seems calm, but I know for sure that the French are on the move.

speaker: Lawson
en: I just watch over these laborers, trying to keep them safe. I am as fair as I can in deciding whom they hire and when they work. I have no idea why these men wish me harm. Do they think I am a wealthy man? Ha ha...

speaker: Gist
en: All quiet, sir. There's nothing out there but ice.

speaker: Gist
en: Enemy ahead!

speaker: Shay
en: Ready cannons!

speaker: Gist
en: There's the flagship, captain!

speaker: Shay
en: With an armada in tow! Concentrate fire on the flagship! If we sink her, the rest may lose their courage!

speaker: Gist
en: Wind's gaining strength, sir!

speaker: Gist
en: French fleet ahead, captain!

speaker: Gist
en: Fireships!

speaker: Shay
en: It's an ambush! Don't let them get close!

speaker: Gist
en: The French flagship, sir!

speaker: Shay
en: Where the blazes are those reinforcements? We'll have to sink her ourselves. Let these French waters be her grave!

speaker: Shay
en: Master Kenway seems determined to destroy Adéwalé.

speaker: Gist
en: Aren't you? He's a powerful man in his own right, and a symbol of hope for the Assassins. Eliminating him would shake them to their core.

speaker: Shay
en: It would, I know. But it seems a shame. He's a good man, Gist.

speaker: Gist
en: So was the elder Washington. And Smith, I rather enjoyed drinking with him. Wardrop too, though the man could not hold his liquor. He and Weeks never got along, you know.

speaker: Shay
en: If you're trying to test my conscience, Gist, you've succeeded.

speaker: Gist
en: We live in a time of war, Shay, but it's always wartime for us. I sound like my Uncle Jedidiah, he was an old sourpuss! Let me tell you

speaker: Shay
en: Another time, Gist.

speaker: Gist
en: Aye, sir.

speaker: Gist
en: Look what the wind just blew in!

speaker: Cook
en: Hail and good morrow, gentlemen!

speaker: Haytham
en: Once again, Captain Cook's resourcefulness has served us well.

speaker: Cook
en: I have located the man you are seeking.

speaker: Shay
en: Adéwalé?

speaker: Cook
en: Exactly. He was last seen in the French fort not two leagues from here, along the river.

speaker: Gist
en: What would that scallywag be doing in a French fort?

speaker: Cook
en: Refitting his vessel I suppose. After Louisbourg...

speaker: Haytham
en: Thank you, Master Cook. We'll take it from here.

speaker: Cook
en: Farewell and Godspeed, gentlemen.

speaker: Gist
en: The fort's just up ahead.

speaker: Shay
en: Good, then let us continue onward.

speaker: Gist
en: Saints preserve us! What is that doing here?

speaker: Shay
en: That makes no sense. Those rivers barely have enough draft for an oceangoing vessel. She'll be nearly impossible to maneuver.

speaker: Haytham
en: Maneuverability is hardly the point.

speaker: Shay
en: Well I don't intend to find out the point. Let's stay out of her way.

speaker: Gist
en: We can find our way around her. Just keep to the smaller rivers where she can't follow.

speaker: Haytham
en: And do try to remain unseen. We don't want to attract any unwanted attention.

speaker: Shay
en: Why would the French bring such a ship inland?

speaker: Haytham
en: As the war is drawing to its close, they are becoming desperate. They'll expend any efforts to gain firepower.

speaker: Gist
en: No offense to Captain Cook, but that lady has more firepower than any I've had the pleasure of meeting.

speaker: Shay
en: It's not really my type.

speaker: Gist
en: Ah, but the French ones can have a certain charm. Did I ever tell you the story of Madame Reinette? That wasn't her REAL name, but—right, not the time. Point is, I think I know a safe place where you can debark. Sail on! So what's the plan? We bombard the fort?

speaker: Haytham
en: It would be foolhardy to simply storm that fort.

speaker: Shay
en: Aye, we need to know what we're up against. I could take care of that.

speaker: Haytham
en: Indeed...

speaker: Shay
en: Let's find a safe place to dock.

speaker: Shay
en: I'll go to the fort. Find out what Adéwalé is doing there. Keep the Morrigan close, Gist.

speaker: Gist
en: Aye, sir. I'll keep her close, and I'll keep her safe.

speaker: Haytham
en: Good luck, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck, Master Kenway.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: So, the Templars sent their dog after me. Time to test your mettle, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: He's getting away. If only he'd stand still and fight me!

speaker: Haytham
en: Adéwalé is facing you on his own terms, picking the battlefield. And on his own ship, he is most at ease.

speaker: Shay
en: Mind those mortars! Else we'll be swimming home tonight!

speaker: Haytham
en: This river is getting uncomfortably narrow.

speaker: Gist
en: Don't you worry, sir! Shay has gotten us out of tighter scrapes before! And the lake ahead is a dead end. Adéwalé won't be able to get out.

speaker: Shay
en: It's fortune, it is! The man-o-war can't follow us anymore.

speaker: Gist
en: Adéwalé's beached his ship!

speaker: Haytham
en: A novel tactic.

speaker: Shay
en: He's saving his crew.

speaker: Haytham
en: No, he's making a last stand. Let's not disappoint him. I will take the high ground and provide a distraction. Find another way. Go after him, Shay. I will circle around. Follow him, Shay. I will try to corner him.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Haytham Kenway.

speaker: Haytham
en: Adéwalé.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Where is your hunting dog, Grand Master Templar? I must have caused quite a ruckus for both of you to be chasing me.

speaker: Haytham
en: Indeed, you have been a thorn in our side for far too long!

speaker: Adéwalé
en: I served with your father, Haytham. He would be ashamed to see what you have become.

speaker: Haytham
en: Really? I wasn't aware my father had a sense of shame.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Do not speak ill of your father, boy! If you become half the man he was, it will be a blessing.

speaker: Haytham
en: Blessing or curse, I am my own man. Have you had enough, old man?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: This old man will put you in an early grave, Haytham!

speaker: Haytham
en: Younger men have tried and failed.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: You are quick, boy! But not very clever! Come! Come! You will die as a traitor!

speaker: Shay
en: Forgive me, Adéwalé.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: You dare beg forgiveness, child? Hell welcomes traitors like you.

speaker: Shay
en: Then I go there proudly, knowing I have done right.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: It does not matter... Achilles already has what he needs.

speaker: Shay
en: I will kill every last man who defends him, if I must. I cannot let him succeed.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: You... have become... a monster, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Perhaps I have.

speaker: Haytham
en: Come.

speaker: Shay
en: So, what's our next heading?

speaker: Liam
en: Wherever this Lawrence Washington docks his arse.

speaker: Shay
en: Liam, you're finally getting into the spirit of things!

speaker: Liam
en: He's a Templar and a politician, what's there to like?

speaker: Shay
en: Good! Hoist anchor!

speaker: Shay
en: Where does Chevalier get off ordering us around like that? We're Assassins, same as him.

speaker: Liam
en: He has more experience and he knows these waters better, Shay. That makes him in charge of these parts.

speaker: Shay
en: Well, he commands me around back at the Homestead too. Is he a truffle pig to know land better than me?

speaker: Liam
en: Show some respect, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: He ought to respect me, Liam! I stick my neck out as much as any of us.

speaker: Liam
en: Yeah, twice as often it seems... But that's just the thing, Chevalier hangs back and thinks before making a decision. His experience has earned him that right.

speaker: Shay
en: I wonder how much experience I'll need before I can decide when to wake up or take action! I swear Liam, sometimes I feel I was more grown up when we were children. We slept rough and scrounged for meat, but at least we decided where and when.

speaker: Hope
en: The Templars desire to understand the nature of these artifacts. Their spies have called upon many doctors and other learned people in New York.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: They have also approached many tribes with questions.

speaker: Liam
en: Yeah, they've been showing that Manuscript far and wide. No one can read the strange writing or understand the images. We do have a name though.

speaker: Shay
en: We learned that Lawrence Washington sent out the Manuscript.

speaker: Achilles
en: Lawrence Washington... Businessman, Virginian politician, and high-ranking Templar.

speaker: Hope
en: Ah yes, I recently heard he was back from the West Indies. One of my men saw his majordomo pick up a strange package.

speaker: Achilles
en: Then that package will be delivered to him promptly. Shay, figure out what it is and find Washington. And when you do... learn all you can.

speaker: Liam
en: I'll prepare the Morrigan.

speaker: Liam
en: Well, if we've any luck, that ship will lead us right to him.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck, Liam. And Washington is running out of his.

speaker: Liam
en: Aye.

speaker: Shay
en: There she is! Alright men, time to be quiet!

speaker: Liam
en: Lawrence Washington is a powerful businessman, a slave owner, and a leading Templar. We lost track of him about a year ago. I recently learned he was in Barbados, but I haven't been able to confirm that. Now...

speaker: Shay
en: Now you think he had something to do with the theft of the artifacts, don't you?

speaker: Liam
en: I wouldn't put it past him. Haiti's a short voyage from Barbados, and his return to the Colonies certainly coincides with the arrival of the artifacts. We cannot let the Templars get control of these Colonies. Whatever happens, Lawrence Washington must not survive.

speaker: Shay
en: I'll make sure he doesn't.

speaker: Liam
en: A blockade, Captain! This won't do. Shay, you must follow that ship on land.

speaker: Shay
en: I'll do that. Bring the Morrigan around another way.

speaker: Liam
en: Aye, Cap'n. Track that passage and find Washington.

speaker: Shay
en: Some blockade.

speaker: Liam
en: And remember what I said, Shay. Washington must die.

speaker: Shay
en: Aye.

speaker: Guard 1
en: What is in this package? The captain would tell us naught but that it was fragile.

speaker: Guard 2
en: Then you need know naught but that.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Come on, throw a dog a bone!

speaker: Guard 2
en: What makes you think I know?

speaker: Shay
en: Now, what's this? A rifle?

speaker: Guard 3
en: You there!

speaker: Guard 3
en: Stay... where... you... are

speaker: Shay
en: How can that be? It makes no sound. Thanks for the present, Master Washington. This is a strange surprise, not quite what I was expecting. Now I must find Washington, and interrogate him...

speaker: Guest 1
en: Splendid party, wouldn't you say?

speaker: Guest 2
en: Indeed. Master Washington has outdone himself.

speaker: Guest 1
en: He has been rather pale, though. And his cough is worse than ever.

speaker: Guard 4
en: Invitation, please.

speaker: Guest 3
en: Here you are. Has there been any trouble?

speaker: Guard 4
en: Not yet. And we hope to keep it that way.

speaker: Shay
en: I need to get to Washington first. Then I'll worry about the artifacts.

speaker: George
en: Brother, are you sure you shouldn't be in bed?

speaker: Lawrence
en: I am fine, George.

speaker: Lawrence
en: Be a good host for my sake. Go to the wine cellar and get something special for our guests.

speaker: George
en: I will. Gentlemen.

speaker: Lawrence
en: My brother is a bright spot in a troubled land. If I may make one request before I depart this life, please leave him in peace. He should have nothing to do with the troubles of the Templar cause.

speaker: Weeks
en: We all respect that sentiment, sir.

speaker: Lawrence
en: You have my thanks, gentlemen. Master Smith, are you ready to leave on your voyage?

speaker: Smith
en: Aye, sir! I shall return with answers.

speaker: Lawrence
en: Master Wardrop, are you likewise engaged with the manuscript?

speaker: Wardrop
en: Yes, sir. We will soon know its meaning.

speaker: Lawrence
en: Then I bid you take your leave.

speaker: Shay
en: Washington can barely stand on his own two feet. You better be right about him, Liam, because I'm about to murder a dying man.

speaker: Lawrence
en: You are too late, Assassin.

speaker: Shay
en: It's never too late to ruin Templars plans, Master Washington.

speaker: Lawrence
en: Ah, ah... but my plans are already in motion. Even leading you here... has given my allies time to escape. Thank you... for making my end a quick one.

speaker: Shay
en: And thank you for revealing your master plan, you scheming snake.

speaker: Shay
en: Goddamit, I'd better hurry. I have to get to the Morrigan! Liam, I hope you brought the ship around! Is that a ship mortar? That's not sporting!

speaker: Shay
en: Lawrence Washington is dead.

speaker: Liam
en: You look disappointed.

speaker: Shay
en: The sickly way that man looked, he would have been dead in a month anyway. And two other Templars got away. They're looking into the Manuscript and Box.

speaker: Liam
en: Did they have the artifacts?

speaker: Shay
en: I don't know... Perhaps... I can't be sure.

speaker: Liam
en: Then you did what was right by the Brotherhood. We can find the objects later. Cheer up, Shay. It's a rare day we can sow such chaos among the Templars.

speaker: Shay
en: Perhaps. But to hear Washington speak, it didn't sound like they'd be too put out by the loss.

speaker: Liam
en: Well, that's what he'd want you to think.

speaker: Haytham
en: Where is your boss?

speaker: Gang member
en: I'll never tell! She'll kill me!

speaker: Shay
en: If you don't tell, he'll kill you.

speaker: Gang member
en: She's in that big mansion. The one with the gardens.

speaker: Haytham
en: Shall we go?

speaker: Shay
en: You didn't mention you had a Hidden Blade.

speaker: Haytham
en: You thought you were the only one?

speaker: Shay
en: Well, yes, I suppose... Where did you get that?

speaker: Haytham
en: It was donated by the Brotherhood.

speaker: Shay
en: I see...

speaker: Shay
en: Our mission was a success. The army should make its move any time now.

speaker: Haytham
en: Good. We lack the resources in New York to handle these criminals ourselves. With a little luck, we might be rid of them once and for all.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck.

speaker: Haytham
en: Now, let us cut off the snake's head...

speaker: Soldier
en: Sir! We can confirm, the woman is inside.

speaker: Captain
en: Perfect. Time to smoke her out!

speaker: Shay
en: I'll go in and get Hope myself.

speaker: Haytham
en: Very well.

speaker: Liam
en: We have everything we need. Now... Chevalier will be expecting me. Hope.

speaker: Hope
en: Bon voyage.

speaker: Hope
en: About time you showed up. Sorry it had to come to this, Shay.

speaker: Hope
en: You were a fascinating fellow.

speaker: Hope
en: You have more endurance than I expected, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: What is this... poison... slows my heart... I... I have to move! That's it! Moving keeps my heart beating. I need to find Hope... Get the antidote! If I stop, I die. I have to move. Need to keep moving!

speaker: Hope
en: You never give up, do you, Shay? No matter. The poison will kill you.

speaker: Hope
en: You're late, again, Shay...

speaker: Shay
en: Hope, I didn't want to do this.

speaker: Hope
en: I trained you to do this. I expected nothing less.

speaker: Shay
en: Then why

speaker: Hope
en: To give Liam time to leave... Soon, Chevalier will be on his way to the Precursor site...

speaker: Shay
en: I will stop him.

speaker: Hope
en: He will see you coming. Pity... You had so much potential...

speaker: Gist
en: The Colonel waits in Albany... I wonder what he has in mind for us to do next.

speaker: Shay
en: Us? I thought you just wanted to check in with Monro, not sign me up for the army.

speaker: Gist
en: Not at all, Shay! But I admire the Colonel's ideals and want to make them happen.

speaker: Shay
en: What kind of ideals?

speaker: Gist
en: Secure borders, prosperous farms, fair trade... We need those in these wretched colonies.

speaker: Shay
en: Sounds like a high-minded utopia.

speaker: Gist
en: It rather does! Want to help make it happen?

speaker: Shay
en: Colonel Monro is an intriguing man, and he certainly seems honorable. We'll head for Albany. After that, I'll see.

speaker: Gist
en: Splendid! Full sail ahead, lads!

speaker: Monro
en: In good health, I see?

speaker: Gist
en: Ehh, thanks to the Captain here.

speaker: Monro
en: Tis a fine vessel, Master Cormac.

speaker: Shay
en: Thank you, Colonel Monro.

speaker: Monro
en: Master Gist, did you learn more about our conspirators and their new weapons?

speaker: Gist
en: Only that their base of operations is a French fort further downriver.

speaker: Shay
en: It's a little close for comfort, isn't it?

speaker: Monro
en: If the French have installed a fort in our territory, they are likely preparing an assault. New York could burn. Will you join us, Master Cormac?

speaker: Shay
en: Aye. Enough innocents have died already.

speaker: Gist
en: Might I suggest we improve our vessel? The Morrigan is good, but with a few more supplies, she could be unstoppable. And, there's a French outpost nearby I happen to know...

speaker: Shay
en: I like the sound of that.

speaker: Shay
en: What sort of business are the French up to there? Just occupying the territory?

speaker: Monro
en: It is an economic incursion more than a geographical one. Some of the ruffians are sponsored by enemies of the colonies. They intend to undermine local authorities.

speaker: Gist
en: I've heard they steal from civilians and resell essential goods for ten times the price..

speaker: Shay
en: It's always the little fellow who gets skinned. Colonel, you and Gist here seem inspired. Is there something in the water, or in the whiskey?

speaker: Monro
en: Now why do you say that, Master Cormac?

speaker: Gist
en: I think Shay here is skeptical about our intentions towards our fellow man.

speaker: Monro
en: I understand, but there is no need. I simply want these colonies to be a place of safety, development, and purpose.

speaker: Shay
en: Funny, I thought rich men wanted them to be a place of profit.

speaker: Monro
en: I am not a rich man, Master Cormac... Money is a means to an end, not an end in and of itself.

speaker: Gist
en: Says you. I think it's a fine end to a game of cards.

speaker: Gist
en: Good show, Shay! Now let's use those materials to give the Morrigan more firepower. We will need more powerful guns before we approach that fort. Go to your cabin to arrange the work.

speaker: Gist
en: Splendid! That fort and her defenders will tremble before the Morrigan!

speaker: Monro
en: Your ship is in fine form, Master Cormac. That fort should offer little resistance.

speaker: Gist
en: I rather hope the frogs offer some, else this will be a dully day.

speaker: Monro
en: Never wish for battle, Master Gist. There is plenty around here for any of our lifetimes.

speaker: Shay
en: Besides, if we find the fort's commander, the French will surrender, no?

speaker: Monro
en: Indeed, that is a sensible strategy. But we will have to wear down the fort's defenses first. Otherwise they will just dig in like a wounded bear.

speaker: Gist
en: There's our target, Shay! Knock her down like a game of nine pins.

speaker: Monro
en: Begin by hitting her towers.

speaker: Gist
en: As the Colonel says!

speaker: Gist
en: Superb! Now find the fort commander!

speaker: Shay
en: Le Chasseur...

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Shay! It has been so long. Were you on a special mission?

speaker: Shay
en: Yes, from Achilles.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: How interesting! So am I.

speaker: Shay
en: Don't make me do this, Le Chasseur!

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Do what, assassinate me? I thought that was your specialty.

speaker: Shay
en: We could both just leave.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Ah, but then I would tell your Brothers that you are still alive. You have to kill me, Shay.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: You were always good at your business, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: As were you. Tell me, what are you doing inland?

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Special weapons... Poisoneous gases to use against colonial authorities. I am merely a delivery man.

speaker: Shay
en: Then may your final delivery be swift.

speaker: Shay
en: Le Chasseur was right... I- I had no other choice. If the Assassins find out I'm alive, they'll come after me.

speaker: Gist
en: While you were busy taking down that fort, I happened to stumble upon the treasury.

speaker: Shay
en: You don't say...

speaker: Gist
en: It was the damndest thing... Well, in any case, amongst other things I found map and charts detailing various French trade routes.

speaker: Shay
en: What are you thinking, Gist?

speaker: Gist
en: I thought perhaps we could use them to, er, help the Royal Navy... and fill our pockets. I stored these maps in your cabin, Captain, should you wish to use them.

speaker: Gist
en: The Colonel thanks you and congratulates you, Shay. He has returned to New York. But, you look troubled.

speaker: Shay
en: Do- Do you ever wonder if you're doing the right thing, Gist? If you chose the right path?

speaker: Gist
en: Ah, I used to, my young friend, but not anymore. Not since I met the Colonel... And what's to question? The French are entrenched in our territory. It's about time we root them out!

speaker: Shay
en: Of course, you're right, Gist. Let's head back to New York.

speaker: Gist
en: Aye, Captain.

speaker: Cook
en: Master Cormac! I didn't expect to see you again so soon.

speaker: Shay
en: I found de la Vérendrye's travel plans, but the devil used some kind of code. I—I can't figure it out. Maybe you'll have better luck?

speaker: Cook
en: How strange... It is a very old cipher. I have seen it once before. I could draw you a map...

speaker: Shay
en: Or... you could accompany me. Help me find de la Vérendrye.

speaker: Cook
en: An urgent matter then. Very well. We shall sail together again.

speaker: Gist
en: I gather you have some history with our friend de la Vérendrye.

speaker: Shay
en: A history of instant loathing. I should have known not to trust... my friends who embraced such a wretch.

speaker: Cook
en: My goodness, what could this fellow have done to inspire such enmity? I know him only as one of a family of explorers, extending the boundaries of the known world.

speaker: Gist
en: From the brief encounters I've had with him, I can tell you he's an irascible person.

speaker: Shay
en: That's a polite way of saying he's a cantankerous bastard.

speaker: Cook
en: But do his actions surpass his words?

speaker: Gist
en: I suspect history will believe so, my dear Cook.

speaker: Shay
en: The actions that enter the history books in any case. Master Cook, how far south have you travelled?

speaker: Cook
en: Oh, not far. Only about Nantucket, really.

speaker: Gist
en: I knew a man from there... But that's another matter. Have you not even been to the West Indies?

speaker: Cook
en: Not yet. But the West Indies are well-mapped already.

speaker: Shay
en: Ah, you're looking for a challenge, are you?

speaker: Cook
en: Well, frankly, yes. My skills are better suited to newly-discovered regions, like Newfoundland and Labrador.

speaker: Shay
en: Say I saw a map... I can't say from where.

speaker: Cook
en: A delicate matter? Diplomatic perhaps?

speaker: Shay
en: You get my meaning. On this map, there were lands I think no man has seen. Well, no man from our Empire at least.

speaker: Cook
en: A land no man has seen... You have me intrigued, where is it?

speaker: Shay
en: South of the Japans and China. As far east of Madagascar as Lisbon is from Boston.

speaker: Cook
en: But... there's nothing there. And it would take an unusually provisioned ship to even attempt that journey.

speaker: Gist
en: I think we know a group that might sponsor such a voyage...

speaker: Shay
en: I'll tell you more later, Captain Cook. A man could make his name with such a daring discovery.

speaker: Gist
en: Did you hear that?

speaker: Shay
en: Cannon fire. Deep within the fog.

speaker: Cook
en: Could it be de la Vérendrye?

speaker: Shay
en: Perhaps. This is a secret expedition. They won't be keen to leave any witnesses to their voyage.

speaker: Crew member
en: Ship ahoy!

speaker: Gist
en: A fleet, Captain. We've found them.

speaker: Cook
en: Let us hope we are not too late. They have us at a serious disadvantage.

speaker: Shay
en: We're gaining on them. The Morrigan won't let us down.

speaker: Crew member
en: This snow has been sent to bedevil us.

speaker: Shay
en: It won't slow us down for long. And perhaps it will help us take them by surprise.

speaker: Gist
en: Brace!

speaker: Cook
en: It's an ambush!

speaker: Shay
en: Steady the ship!

speaker: Shay
en: Where are they?!

speaker: Gist
en: They're within mortar range. That's all I know.

speaker: Cook
en: It's the Gerfaut!

speaker: Gist
en: Irksome to the last. De la Vérendrye must have stayed behind to stop us.

speaker: Shay
en: And no doubt volunteered for the job.

speaker: Gist
en: Don't sink her! We still need de La Vérendrye's charts!

speaker: Shay
en: She's dead in the water! Prepare for boarding!

speaker: Chevalier
en: So you think you can best me, boy? Je me suis longuement entraîné avec mon fusil, je tirerai dans le mille cette fois-ci. (I've been practicing my aim, I'll get a bullseye this time.) You have gone soft, Shay! Is that all a Templar can do? Give up your foolish quest! You will die in these waters! No one will remember your name! Mine will be legend! The Assassins will make sure you are forgotten!

speaker: Chevalier
en: So, cabbage farmer, are you still convinced the Templars are right?

speaker: Shay
en: Convinced to the end.

speaker: Shay
en: You bastard! Achilles and Liam have already headed north!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Hope was right... I do make... a good... distraction.

speaker: Shay
en: Thanks for your help, Captain Cook.

speaker: Cook
en: You are welcome, Captain Cormac. Sailing with you is certainly... interesting.

speaker: Gist
en: Trouble does seem to find us, it's true.

speaker: Cook
en: Tell me the truth... Are you fellows with a larger organization? The . You take your orders directly from His Majesty, don't you?

speaker: Gist
en: We couldn't tell you even if we were.

speaker: Shay
en: You should have these maps. De la Vérendrye won't need them anymore. We'll contact you in regards to sponsoring future voyages, Captain.

speaker: Cook
en: Much obliged.

speaker: Shay
en: Ugh...

speaker: Barry
en: Huh, good to see you're feeling better.

speaker: Shay
en: Thank you... Mister Finnegan, was it?

speaker: Barry
en: Sweet Mother Mary, have we taken in the village idiot?

speaker: Cassidy
en: Barry! Remember, Shay, I'm Cassidy and this is...

speaker: Barry
en: Barry.

speaker: Cassidy
en: You've been ill for weeks.

speaker: Shay
en: I hate to have been a burden.

speaker: Cassidy
en: See, he's a civilized fellow.

speaker: Barry
en: Aye, for a clumsy deckhand. Probably fell off his ship half-drunk.

speaker: Cassidy
en: BARRY!

speaker: Shay
en: He's right...

speaker: Barry
en: What do you all want?

speaker: Cassidy
en: Aaaahhh!

speaker: Shay
en: What's going on?

speaker: Cassidy
en: You wretch! How dare you!

speaker: Man
en: Shut up, woman!

speaker: Cassidy
en: Ow!

speaker: Barry
en: Leave her alone! Argh!

speaker: Shay
en: Now what are you going on about?

speaker: Gang member 1
en: Stay out of this, you fool!

speaker: Shay
en: Well I was going to, but now you've made things personal...

speaker: Barry
en: Aaarrgghh! And don't come back! Thank you, Shay. In me younger days, I could have taken them one-handed!

speaker: Shay
en: Why were these men bothering you?

speaker: Barry
en: Oh, the usual. They feel they're owed money because they're not harming citizens. Mark me words, those gangs are going to be the downfall of this city.

speaker: Cassidy
en: Wait here. I have something for ya.

speaker: Cassidy
en: Won't do you any good walking around starkers... Here, try these on. They were our son's.

speaker: Barry
en: I suppose if you're looking for trouble, you'll be needing these.

speaker: Shay
en: Thank you.

speaker: Cassidy
en: Ah, don't you look a right gentleman!

speaker: Barry
en: Cass!

speaker: Shay
en: Did I have a book with me?

speaker: Barry
en: Hmm... Just those peculiar weapons.

speaker: Shay
en: Thank you both. If you'll excuse me. Then the Manuscript is at the bottom of the Atlantic...

speaker: Gang member 1
en: You again! You'll regret this! The Finnegans are dead. Hear me? Dead!

speaker: Gang member 1
en: Putting your nose in other people's business ain't nice! You picked the wrong side! You'll regret this! And so will the Finnegans! My friends will want to meet you!

speaker: Shay
en: What have you and your friends got against the Finnegans?

speaker: Gang member 1
en: I got no gripe! My boss sent me over.

speaker: Shay
en: Ah? And where is he set up?

speaker: Gang member 1
en: You can't miss it! There's always black smoke rising from the courtyard of that building!

speaker: Gang member 2
en: This is our turf, and you're no friend of ours.

speaker: Gang member 3
en: If you're looking for trouble, trouble will find you.

speaker: Gang member 4
en: You don't belong here. Sod off! Hey! Move away... or die!

speaker: Gang member 5
en: You! Get out of here!

speaker: Gang leader
en: We own this town, boy! You won't get out of here alive! Look what the cat dragged in. What are you waiting for? Kill him! We'll give you a lesson! Stay out of our business. Get him, boys!

speaker: Shay
en: Don't make this difficult for yourselves...

speaker: Shay
en: That will help with smoke...

speaker: Monro
en: Be at ease, Master Cormac. We are friends. The Finnegans were worried you might take matters into your own hands. I am Colonel George Monro.

speaker: Shay
en: Colonel.

speaker: Monro
en: I came to help, but I see I am late. Thank you for dealing with these foul criminals. They were a blight on New York.

speaker: Shay
en: What do you care? You redcoats are nothing but landlords. The townsfolk here are grinding away, trying to make a living.

speaker: Monro
en: I cannot blame you for having that impression. Some of my comrades have been less than helpful. But I take a different approach.

speaker: Shay
en: And what is that?

speaker: Monro
en: I care. I want to see these colonists safe and prosperous.

speaker: Shay
en: Noble words.

speaker: Monro
en: Perhaps actions will convince you otherwise, Master Cormac. Here, reclaim what they have stolen.

speaker: Monro
en: Now, let us use some of that money for the good of the city. I realize you have no reason to trust me, Master Cormac.

speaker: Shay
en: You said you were a friend of the Finnegans.

speaker: Monro
en: I am. Their late son... worked for me. You are much like him.

speaker: Shay
en: How so?

speaker: Monro
en: He cared. And he wanted to do good by the people. We shared a dream, he and I, that of making the world a better place. Mere survival is not enough. Full bellies, warm clothing... Freedom from want is the greatest freedom of all.

speaker: Shay
en: It almost sounds like you have good will towards the people you govern.

speaker: Monro
en: I do not govern, Master Cormac. I merely assist.

speaker: Monro
en: See this neglected edifice, Master Cormac? We can make it better. Urban renewal is a new science, but one that has already proven effective on the Continent. I have arranged for resources, use them to improve that building.

speaker: Monro
en: I suspect New York will prosper under your watch, Master Cormac. You can do great things for this city and its citizens. After all, a man needs purpose. Farewell for now, Master Cormac.

speaker: Shay
en: I have the Manuscript.

speaker: Liam
en: Great. Hope is waiting for you in Sleepy Hollow.

speaker: Shay
en: What's in Sleepy Hollow?

speaker: Liam
en: Benjamin Franklin. The man Johnson hired to make that strange Precursor box work.

speaker: Shay
en: So what's the plan?

speaker: Liam
en: Meet Hope, impersonate one of Johnson's men, and give the Box and Manuscript to Franklin.

speaker: Shay
en: So I'm a messenger then?

speaker: Liam
en: Aye. See if this Franklin can figure out how this damned Box operates. And stay with him. Oh, and as far as we can tell, this man doesn't know about the Templars, or the Assassins for that matter.

speaker: Shay
en: Oh, a simple task.

speaker: Liam
en: For a simple man.

speaker: Hope
en: You're late. The sky is getting temperamental.

speaker: Shay
en: That's not the only thing, is it?

speaker: Shay
en: Uh, Master Franklin, sir. My name is Shay and this is my associate Hope. William Johnson told us to give you these.

speaker: Franklin
en: Thank you, but I am afraid I must delay my experiment.

speaker: Hope
en: Delay it? Why?

speaker: Franklin
en: The army confiscated my lightning rods. They are essential to conducting the electricity I need to vivify your Box.

speaker: Shay
en: Master Johnson would not want you to have to wait.

speaker: Franklin
en: Perhaps there is something you can do then. Soldiers have been hauling things away all day. Perhaps they could tell you where they have taken my lightning rods so you could get them back.

speaker: Shay
en: At your service, sir.

speaker: Hope
en: Begin your investigation at the market near the docks. I will stay here and help with the preparations.

speaker: Franklin
en: This is intolerable! I can barely conduct my research anymore!

speaker: Hope
en: Everyone is having metal confiscated nowadays.

speaker: Franklin
en: Yes, yes... the army will melt it down and turn it into weapons... War is upon us.

speaker: Hope
en: So, Master Franklin, what is this?

speaker: Franklin
en: A Leyden jar. It temporarily stores power in the form of vitreous and resinous electricity.

speaker: Hope
en: Really? What will you do with the jar when it is full?

speaker: Franklin
en: Ah, what will I do with all my jars! For this experiment, we will need an entire energy storage system. The many units fire at once, so I call it a "battery". It should make your interpretation box operate.

speaker: Hope
en: Fascinating.

speaker: Guard 1
en: My word, this is heavy.

speaker: Guard 2
en: The weather is getting worse. You know where the warehouse is, soldier.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Aye, sir.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Don't look now, but I think I'm being followed.

speaker: Guard 3
en: I'm sure you're seeing things, but I'll take a butcher's.

speaker: Guard 4
en: Did you see that strange stuff in Benjamin Franklin's garden?

speaker: Guard 5
en: I keep well clear of that place. They say that man messes with lightning!

speaker: Guard 4
en: Speaking of lightning, I reckon there's a storm coming.

speaker: Guard 5
en: Aye. Let's hope she demurs until we're off duty.

speaker: Man
en: Hey darling, you up for a pint?

speaker: Woman
en: Sure, if you bring your mates!

speaker: Man
en: That's bleak...

speaker: Guard 2
en: Is that the last of it?

speaker: Guard 1
en: Yes it is, sir.

speaker: Guard 2
en: Good, put it with the rest.

speaker: Guard 6
en: The citizens aren't happy. Someone threw garbage at me today!

speaker: Guard 7
en: So that's what I smell!

speaker: Guard 6
en: Don't laugh. If the Commander keeps this up, we'll have a riot on our hands.

speaker: Guard 7
en: Well, I'd be mad too if half of what I owned was confiscated.

speaker: Guard 6
en: It's the iron we need... mostly.

speaker: Guard 7
en: Tell that to the citizens!

speaker: Guard 6
en: You know, I bet not one of them will thank us when we win this war.

speaker: Guard 8
en: So what are we gonna do with all this metal?

speaker: Guard 9
en: Melt it down, I suppose. Forge swords, muskets...

speaker: Guard 8
en: Ah, this damned war.

speaker: Guard 9
en: I pray King George sends reinforcements soon.

speaker: Shay
en: I wonder what Master Franklin plans to do with these rods.

speaker: Shay
en: This storm's getting worse. Better hurry back to Franklin.

speaker: Franklin
en: Shay! Thank goodness, quick, help me with the rods.

speaker: Hope
en: It's a map... Where is that?

speaker: Shay
en: Portugal. Lisbon, I'd stake my life on it.

speaker: Hope
en: Make yourself scarce, Shay. The militia will be here any minute. I'm sure they will have questions.

speaker: Shay
en: What about you?

speaker: Hope
en: I'm a devoted housekeeper.

speaker: Shay
en: Right.

speaker: Shay
en: So what's the next city you want me to smite?! What happened in Haiti happened in Portugal. A great earthquake. Thousands dead, thanks to your damned Manuscript!

speaker: Achilles
en: This cannot be.

speaker: Hope
en: Shay, a person cannot start an earthquake.

speaker: Shay
en: A person meddling with these Precursor machines could. You saw the Box, Hope. The Temple was filled to bursting with that kind of power. You made me SLAUGHTER INNOCENTS!

speaker: Hope
en: How dare you!

speaker: Shay
en: You defend him? Achilles sent me in there like Mackandal sent his man in Haiti. He knew.

speaker: Liam
en: What the hell's going on? Stop this!

speaker: Achilles
en: The operation was delicate, perhaps you

speaker: Shay
en: You are shifting the earth itself. Who are you to decide what city falls next?

speaker: Achilles
en: Get him out of here.

speaker: Shay
en: Liam is a fool if he thinks I'll leave this be. Achilles cannot be trusted. He must never find another Precursor Temple. I don't care that he's Mentor, or that his family is dead. There's no excuse for this level of madness!

speaker: Shay
en: Only one thing to do.

speaker: Shay
en: There's no turning back now...

speaker: Achilles
en: I had such hopes for you, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Achilles. I have to do this.

speaker: Achilles
en: And what is it you're doing exactly? Stealing from your Brothers? Betraying me?

speaker: Shay
en: Someone must make amends.

speaker: Achilles
en: Make amends? You have no idea what you're doing. The future of the whole continent, maybe the whole world, is tied up in that Manuscript.

speaker: Shay
en: Perhaps. But we don't have the right to decide that future.

speaker: Achilles
en: The right? We have the responsibility!

speaker: Shay
en: WE are responsible for killing innocents and destroying cities! This... mad grab for power. It ends now.

speaker: Achilles
en: I will not let you destroy everything we have built!

speaker: Achilles
en: Assassins! Stop him! Stop Shay!

speaker: Assassins
en: Mortars! Run! Run away! Has Chevalier gone mad? He'll destroy the manor! Take cover! Move! Get out of here! Watch out! What is de la Vérendrye doing?! Chevalier's using mortars to stop Shay! What's he thinking? He'll blast us to pieces!

speaker: Hope
en: You won't hinder our plans! How could you, Shay? Have you gone mad? Haven't I taught you anything? Won't you listen to reason, Shay?

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: I will not let you run away. You cannot escape! I can see you! You will have to run faster than that!

speaker: Liam
en: That's enough!

speaker: Hope
en: Give back the Manuscript, Shay. I'm sure Achilles

speaker: Shay
en: I cannot. I will not let this happen again. All those souls lost... One more hardly matters.

speaker: Liam
en: Shay!

speaker: Achilles
en: What is our progress on the Precursor matter?

speaker: Chevalier
en: We are gathering ships and supplies, but it is difficult without a specific destination.

speaker: Hope
en: My men can help. I have enough to spare for a crew as well, Chevalier.

speaker: Achilles
en: And you are confident you can do this?

speaker: Hope
en: I am a keen observer, Mentor. The device will be ready shortly.

speaker: Achilles
en: Very good. Keep me apprised.

speaker: Shay
en: We've yet to find where Hope is hiding... and most criminals in New York report to her now. I better find the Grand Master...

speaker: Shay
en: Things are worse than we feared. The Assassins found a way to make the Precursor box work. They're already preparing an expedition.

speaker: Haytham
en: Then we must stop them.

speaker: Shay
en: Hope controls hundreds of men. The authorities are doing sod all.

speaker: Weeks
en: What if we were to impersonate her men? We could commit a crime so big, they couldn't ignore those damned brigands anymore.

speaker: Haytham
en: That sounds like an excellent plan, Jack. Make it so. I will find out where the Assassins are hiding.

speaker: Shay
en: Is it just me or did the boss tell us to make trouble?

speaker: Weeks
en: Enjoy it while you can, Shay.

speaker: Weeks
en: Get them, Shay! We'll need their clothes!

speaker: Gang member 1
en: I think we're being followed!

speaker: Gang member 2
en: You're right! Let's move!

speaker: Gang member 1
en: Come on! I'm too young to die! Hurry, you fool! Or we're both dead men!

speaker: Weeks
en: Don't we make a disgraceful pair of crooks?

speaker: Shay
en: No, I make this look good. So what's the target?

speaker: Weeks
en: The military pay. We'll have to hurry. A regiment is already on its way to the fort where the coins are kept.

speaker: Shay
en: Great... And I suppose you have a plan?

speaker: Weeks
en: The fort holds many prisoners... Get in and hoist the gang's colors. When you do, I'll free them.

speaker: Shay
en: You're going to free a bunch of criminals working with the Assassins?

speaker: Weeks
en: Well, we have to turn the army against them, don't we? Remember: You raise the flag and I'll raise hell!

speaker: Guards
en: To arms! Damn! Defend the payroll! There's too many of them! Don't let them get our pay! Fight! Fight! Take that! Back in your cell, wretch! Surrender now, or die!

speaker: Prisoners
en: Time to take down this fort, boys! Get 'em! Take that, lobster! The fort is ours! We're not going back!

speaker: Captain
en: What on earth happened here?

speaker: Guard 1
en: The prisoners got loose!

speaker: Guard 2
en: They had help from outside.

speaker: Guard 1
en: There were just too many of them!

speaker: Captain
en: Well then, we're going to have to fix that, aren't we? It's about time we took those criminals down.

speaker: Shay
en: It worked, Jack!

speaker: Weeks
en: With a little luck, the army will crush those damned brigands.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck.

speaker: Shay
en: From the Colonel...

speaker: Monro
en: Dear Master Cormac, my apologies for the brevity of this missive, but it is time we were honest with one another. You have demonstrated your loyalty and resourcefulness to the Templar cause, and this despite (and perhaps because of) your Assassin origins. The Manuscript the Assassins sought has been in my possession for some time. I reclaimed it when my men found you marooned. The Grand Master himself charged me to discover its meaning, a task I regret I have failed to complete. I leave it in your charge, Master Cormac. There is no one else I trust more. Now I leave for Fort William Henry, an ill-prepared garrison surrounded by hostile natives and the French Army. We have requested reinforcements, but I doubt they will be forthcoming. I have no illusions that our resistance will be successful. I commit my life to the British Army, and my soul to the Father of Understanding. Yours, Colonel George Monro.

speaker: Shay
en: Man your post, Gist! The Colonel's in trouble.

speaker: Gist
en: How do you mean 'in trouble'?

speaker: Shay
en: He's at Fort William Henry, facing impossible odds.

speaker: Gist
en: Get off your lazy arses, lads! And man your stations! We raise anchor! Sorry for the early libation, Captain. But do you realize it has been a year since we met? A whole year! Change my life, you did... And for the better! You will forgive me if I have been, er, celebrating without you.

speaker: Shay
en: A whole year... Gist, I've a question for you. How long have you known of my, well, former allegiance?

speaker: Gist
en: Oh, you mean the Assassins? I knew that ages ago, Shay! I may be drunk, but I'm not blind. Or did you think I would assume you had escaped from some homicidal circus?

speaker: Shay
en: Why didn't you say anything?

speaker: Gist
en: Well, the Colonel wanted us to avoid the subject so it wouldn't, you know, influence your decision-making. You saved my life out of pure selfless instinct, and helped countless others besides. If it were up to me, I would have made you an official Templar months ago.

speaker: Shay
en: Who's it up to then? Monro mentioned a Grand Master...

speaker: Gist
en: Oh yes. The Grand Master of the Colonial Rite. You'd like him, Shay. His father was an Assassin.

speaker: Shay
en: Really... He must have a story to tell.

speaker: Gist
en: What is the news from Fort William Henry?

speaker: Shay
en: The garrison is surrounded and reinforcements are late.

speaker: Gist
en: General Montcalm has been blazing a path across the Colonies for King Louis, hasn't he?

speaker: Shay
en: I rather wish he'd stayed home with his mistress.

speaker: Gist
en: His or King Louis'?

speaker: Shay
en: Either! Though I suspect the King's is finer.

speaker: Gist
en: Indeed, Madame is supposed to be quite the charmer.

speaker: Shay
en: An O'Murphy is in the French King's bed? Now I know you're pulling my leg...

speaker: Weeks
en: Shay! You are a sight for sore eyes!

speaker: Shay
en: Jack?

speaker: Weeks
en: Colonel Monro surrendered to General Montcalm. The French and their Abenaki allies took Fort Henry. Johnson was supposed to bring reinforcements here...

speaker: Shay
en: I don't see anyone else.

speaker: Weeks
en: The Abenaki are restless. They don't understand the terms of surrender and refuse to heed Montcalm. The Colonel and his men were released this morning. They're walking into an ambush...

speaker: Shay
en: Wait here, in case Johnson arrives. I'll- I'll protect the Colonel.

speaker: Weeks
en: Thank you.

speaker: Shay
en: Maybe, I can finally repay my debt to him.

speaker: Shay
en: I hope I'm not too late!

speaker: Soldiers
en: Take that! Death to our enemies! Rrrrraaaahhh!

speaker: Monro
en: Good work, men. Man your positions!

speaker: Soldier
en: That's the last of them.

speaker: Monro
en: Master Cormac?!

speaker: Shay
en: Sir, we must hurry. We should bring what's left of your men to the Morrigan.

speaker: Monro
en: A welcome offer, Captain Cormac. Follow me! Safe passage is ahead.

speaker: Shay
en: So if you don't mind me asking, what happened at Fort William Henry?

speaker: Monro
en: Poor planning and poorer luck, I am afraid. Montcalm was able to bombard us for days.

speaker: Shay
en: Damn frog.

speaker: Monro
en: Actually, he acted with great honor. When we sent for parlay, he returned an offer far more generous than anticipated. We kept our arms, and more importantly, our colors.

speaker: Shay
en: Only to walk into a trap.

speaker: Monro
en: I would hardly expect the French to defend us. Would you?

speaker: Shay
en: No, I wouldn't.

speaker: Monro
en: You continue to prove your loyalty to the Templars, Master Cormac. Risking your life for me...

speaker: Shay
en: We're not out of the woods yet, Colonel. As for my loyalty... Well, I do owe you, don't I? You... saved my life... gave me a second chance.

speaker: Monro
en: We have been working together for a year now. During that time you have rendered many great services. Whatever debt you imagine you have towards me is paid, wouldn't you say?

speaker: Shay
en: Perhaps...

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: You live!? Attack!

speaker: Shay
en: Take cover!

speaker: Monro
en: Keep together, men!

speaker: Shay
en: I'll take out as many as I can.

speaker: Shay
en: Alright, Colonel. Keep your men moving. I'll scout ahead and signal if there's trouble.

speaker: Monro
en: A sensible strategy. Very well, I will lead my men around slowly.

speaker: Shay
en: Hurry! Kesegowaase will not relent.

speaker: Monro
en: Kesegowaase? You know this man, Master Cormac.

speaker: Shay
en: Aye, Colonel. He is one of Achilles' men. An Assassin... as I was.

speaker: Monro
en: So they know I am a Templar. And now this Assassin knows you live.

speaker: Shay
en: And work with Templars. I'm no fool, Colonel. The Assassins will come after me next. We're both targets now.

speaker: Shay
en: You know that's a trap, right?

speaker: Monro
en: Indeed, Master Cormac. But we have little choice. We survived the French cannons, we will survive this. This way! Come, follow me. Make haste!

speaker: Shay
en: Loose the sails!

speaker: Gist
en: You heard the Captain, men! Let's get out of here! Move! Move!

speaker: Weeks
en: Shay! Mmmrrraaaaah!

speaker: Monro
en: I owe you my life, Master Cormac.

speaker: Shay
en: As do I, Colonel.

speaker: Monro
en: We have much to discuss. However, I must tend to my troops.

speaker: Weeks
en: Sir. I will accompany you to Johnson's trading post at .

speaker: Monro
en: Then I shall depart at once. Master Cormac, meet me there.

speaker: Monro
en: Ah, Master Cormac. What you have learned from Le Chasseur was confirmed. The local lawbreakers are changing tactics.

speaker: Shay
en: What's their plan now?

speaker: Monro
en: Their boss has hired Benjamin Franklin to produce new weapons for them. He's very well-guarded.

speaker: Shay
en: Benjamin Franklin... The scientist?

speaker: Monro
en: You have heard of him, good. He is making equipment to spread gases among the populace. Toxic ones, as it turns out.

speaker: Shay
en: The populace? I thought they would use it against the authorities. Though that would be terrible as well...

speaker: Monro
en: The ruffians we have arrested refer to an intimidating woman. I believe she is behind these nefarious plans.

speaker: Shay
en: I'll look into this.

speaker: Monro
en: Thank you.

speaker: Shay
en: Hope... I pray it's not you.

speaker: Gang member 1
en: Did you see him today?

speaker: Gang member 2
en: No, he hasn't stepped outside in days.

speaker: Gang member 3
en: What's Franklin working on?

speaker: Gang member 4
en: Not sure, but it sounds explosive. The boss really wants Franklin isolated.

speaker: Gang member 5
en: Uh huh. No one interrupts his work.

speaker: Gang member 3
en: Really?

speaker: Franklin
en: Shay? It is good to see you again! Your friend Hope said you were away.

speaker: Shay
en: I... was. Sir, I—I've come to collect the results of your experiments.

speaker: Franklin
en: Oh, well... It's a very good thing then, I just finished fixing the prototype. Here you go!

speaker: Franklin
en: I was preparing to leave for Philadelphia, and then Europe. I was invited to lecture in London. Oh! Would you be so kind as to inform Mistress Hope?

speaker: Shay
en: Of course.

speaker: Shay
en: God, Hope... What are you doing with these felons? Turning the city against itself? What have you become?

speaker: Monro
en: Is something the matter, Master Cormac?

speaker: Shay
en: No no, yes, just... old memories.

speaker: Monro
en: When I am issued new recruits burdened with regrets, I tell them the surest way to lose them is with gunpowder.

speaker: Shay
en: You're right, Colonel.

speaker: Monro
en: This prototype seems very powerful. Use it with care, Master Cormac. Our intelligence says this thing can destroy certain fortifications, as well as injure several enemies at once. There is also a more subtle way to use it. Some of these grenades contain a strong sedative. Fire one into the crowd and they will fall asleep immediately. We should test this new weapon. Use it against that door. Use these grenades to destroy that door. Go ahead, Master Cormac, shoot the door.

speaker: Monro
en: Good work. I think you are ready to turn this new weapon against the ruffians who would have used it. There is an abandoned factory nearby, hiding a dangerous poison. Right now, it only causes sleep... But I fear those outlaws are distilling it. A more powerful formula could sicken or perhaps even kill most of New York.

speaker: Shay
en: Then that's my first target.

speaker: Monro
en: Be careful, Master Cormac. We understand that the ingredients are... highly unstable.

speaker: Shay
en: All the better.

speaker: Shay
en: Hmm, if I mess with this, maybe I can break the whole system.

speaker: Gang members
en: This is dangerous! Stop this, you fool! Are you crazy!? You'll pay for this! The whole place will blow up! Stay away! This is dangerous. Hey! What are you doing here!?

speaker: Shay
en: I must get out, or I'm as good as dead.

speaker: Gist
en: Ahh. What marvelous destruction, Captain! I saw the smoke all the way from the Morrigan!

speaker: Monro
en: That should discourage those miscreants. New York is safe, for now.

speaker: Shay
en: With all due respect, Colonel, it's going to take more than a few explosions to get rid of this kind of trouble.

speaker: Johnson
en: The boy is right, Colonel Monro.

speaker: Weeks
en: Shay, was it? Congratulations, you just burned a whole lot of rats out of New York. I'm Jack Weeks, this is William Johnson. I don't know about him, but I'm pleased to meet you.

speaker: Shay
en: Pleased to meet you as well.

speaker: Gist
en: It is terribly dusty here. I'm sure Shay can recount his adventures to us over a pint. Hey, the first round's on... the Colonel, eh!

speaker: Monro
en: Is something the matter, Master Cormac?

speaker: Shay
en: Just a little confused... I must have breathed some of that gas.

speaker: Monro
en: Some ale will do you good. Come, we are all friends here, you will be taken care of.

speaker: Shay
en: The nearest Bureau is near Mount Vernon. Hope will be expecting me...

speaker: Hope
en: Lisbon is near as large as London or Paris. Are you sure you can find this one place?

speaker: Shay
en: I saw it clear as day, Hope. It's a convent, right close by the harbour. I might have visited the sisters once or twice...

speaker: Achilles
en: Given your present knowledge of the site, this duty falls upon you. You understand what must be done?

speaker: Shay
en: Find the Precursor Temple and retrieve the Piece of Eden.

speaker: Hope
en: We finally obtained a ship for crossing the ocean. Have no worries, I will keep the Morrigan safe in New York.

speaker: Shay
en: Thank you. Liam and I will leave straight away.

speaker: Achilles
en: Liam is unavailable at present. Your crew and ship await. Be careful, Shay. Pieces of Eden are powerful relics.

speaker: Shay
en: . What a sight. And here I am, looking for a relic from the time before Adam and Eve... Strange days indeed.

speaker: Shay
en: This must be it! The Precursor site...

speaker: Shay
en: What do we have here?

speaker: Shay
en: The artifact!

speaker: Crew member
en: How could God do this to them?

speaker: Shay
en: God had nothing to do with this.

speaker: Achilles
en: It has been a long time.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Achilles.

speaker: Achilles
en: Adéwalé! How go things in the West Indies?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Very poorly, I'm afraid.

speaker: Achilles
en: Your countenance tells me we should discuss this. Come.

speaker: Shay
en: Who's our visitor?

speaker: Liam
en: That's Adéwalé. He was a slave who freed himself and hundreds of his brothers in the West Indies. That man's a living incarnation of the Creed.

speaker: Shay
en: I see...

speaker: Liam
en: You join me for some practice.

speaker: Shay
en: Soon. I've got other business first.

speaker: Achilles
en: Tell me what happened, old friend.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: It was terrible, Achilles. The ground shook, and the ocean waves crashed over Port-au-Prince...

speaker: Achilles
en: How many were lost?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Thousands. No family was left untouched.

speaker: Achilles
en: I hate to bring up practical matters at a time like this, but did Mackandal's man complete his task before the earthquake hit?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: I cannot know. Vendredi has not been found. He was a strong Maroon, one of Mackandal's best students.

speaker: Achilles
en: Such a shame. So we cannot know if he found the site.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Indeed. But if there was a temple under the waves, I doubt it is still standing.

speaker: Achilles
en: And the artifacts that showed the way?

speaker: Adéwalé
en: Stolen. The Templars broke in during the chaos. They seized the Manuscript and Precursor box. I gave chase on the sea, but lost their trail when they reached New York.

speaker: Achilles
en: We must consider what to do next.

speaker: Assassin 1
en: Adéwalé looked worried earlier. I heard that Liam's waiting for you... Seen him yet?

speaker: Assassin 2
en: I hear Mistress Hope was looking for you.

speaker: Hope
en: You are late.

speaker: Shay
en: Hope! What did I miss?

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Only the first hour of training.

speaker: Shay
en: We're always training, Kesegowaase!

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: And will continue to do so.

speaker: Hope
en: Do not waste your words. Shay abhors improvement as much as cats abhor leashes.

speaker: Shay
en: Hey!

speaker: Hope
en: A pity, the boy has so much potential... But so little discipline.

speaker: Shay
en: Alright, alright! What would you have me do?

speaker: Liam
en: Well played.

speaker: Hope
en: It's about time you showed up.

speaker: Shay
en: Far be it from me to keep a lady waiting.

speaker: Hope
en: I'm no lady here, don't you forget it! I'm your teacher... and your better.

speaker: Shay
en: Well some of that is true, at least. What will we be doing?

speaker: Hope
en: Exploring a myriad ways to end a life. You two! Make yourselves useful and watch Shay. Can you kill without being noticed?

speaker: Hope
en: Attack from around a corner and your target will never know what hit him. Ah, the classic haystack. Hide in it, then surprise your target when he gets close. Take the high ground, Shay. Dispatching from the air is most effective. Stay low and stick to the brush. Be patient and you might hit your target.

speaker: Hope
en: Top form, Shay. Nicely done. I am surprised. You certainly know how to handle yourself.

speaker: Hope
en: You did better than I expected. Have your skills actually grown, Shay? Oh, do not get a swelled head over it. Don't you have other business? No one appreciates it when you are late. And you are always late... Remember what I taught you. Be patient. Be silent. Never let them see you coming. I will meet you later, Shay. For dinner, perhaps? I would love to talk to you, Shay, but this is not the time. Better go now. The others will be waiting.

speaker: Shay
en: So, what's the challenge today?

speaker: Liam
en: Shooting straight and true. Here, you can use these.

speaker: Shay
en: These are yours...

speaker: Liam
en: Well, I want you to have half a chance of succeeding. Go on. Shoot these targets. You can take your time... But not too much, we have more work after this.

speaker: Liam
en: Reload!

speaker: Liam
en: Anyone can hit targets standing still. Let's see how you do on the run.

speaker: Liam
en: Come on! Hurry up! Reload! You're almost there!

speaker: Liam
en: Well done, Shay. Keep it up. You're doing alright, Shay. But don't let the others vex you, they mean well, though they'll never show it. That was good, Shay. We'll continue tomorrow... We'll talk later, Shay. Let's have a pint this evening. Don't let Chevalier get into your head. He'll come around... You better go on now...

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Shay. Follow me. It is time you learned to survive in the frontier.

speaker: Shay
en: I think I've been managing well enough so far.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Perhaps, but there is more I can teach you.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: I am waiting...

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: It is time for the hunt. Use all your senses together to find prey.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Killing should not be meaningless. We must use what nature gives us.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Good. Now to use what you have taken from nature.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: With these, you can keep your pistols close. I hope that you will demonstrate more skill to your other teachers. Do not be late next time. You have done well, Shay. Remember what I taught you. The lesson is over for today, Shay. Farewell for now. Achilles has one more thing to show you.

speaker: Assassin 3
en: Good

speaker: Assassin 3
en: Good, don't let your guard down.

speaker: Assassin 3
en: How goes your training?

speaker: Achilles
en: Shay! I hear you've become quite the marksman.

speaker: Shay
en: A generous gift. Thank you, mentor.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: My ship awaits, Achilles. The people of Haiti will make good use of your supplies. I trust you will retrieve what has been lost.

speaker: Shay
en: Lost?

speaker: Achilles
en: The Templars stole two precious artifacts. A manuscript of ancient wisdom, and a box that allows one to understand its language.

speaker: Adéwalé
en: I have tracked the Templars as far as this coast, but I fear the rest is up to you, my friend...

speaker: Achilles
en: Farewell, Adéwalé.

speaker: Achilles
en: Whoever controls the artifacts can access Precursor sites of power. We must recover them or none are safe.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: The Colonel strikes me as an honorable man. Someone who wants to do what's right... And he may have a point. With everything that has happened... with what I've done... I can't change the past, but maybe there's a future for me here. And maybe, just maybe, I can do what's right this time. I should head back to the Finnegans. Let them know I'm fine.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Cassidy
en: Shay! Colonel Monro told us what happened!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Barry
en: You sir, are a fool. But thanks.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Monro
en: Master Cormac. I am sorry to bother you when you are barely out of your sickbed.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: No, I- I've had enough of being cooped up.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Monro
en: Then perhaps you could get a friend of mine out of trouble? He discovered a nest of criminals developing strange weapons.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Monro
en: Look at these. Bullets as loud and bright as firecrackers. If we might have a moment alone...

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Monro
en: His name is Christopher Gist, and he might be in over his head. I fear these brutes will hang him like a dog.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: I will not let those outlaws have another victim.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Monro
en: Good. The villains are entrenched at old Fort Arsenal. I have urgent business in Albany. Please tell Master Gist to join me there.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Woman 1
en: Did you hear, dearie? They are hanging a man in the old fort!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Woman 2
en: Oh, t'would be a shame to miss that!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gang member 1
en: This bastard nicked what we rightfully stole! Let's say we give him a stretch!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gang member 2
en: Kill him!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gang member 3
en: Let him hang!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Go to hell, the lot of you!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: These ruffians are part of the same gang who made trouble for the Finnegans...

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: Christopher Gist? I'm Shay Cormac.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Charmed! But... What are you doing here, if you don't mind me asking?

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: The Colonel sent me.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Ah ha!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Good show, Shay! Ran them right out of their own den!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: Well, I was looking for a new place to live...

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Well don't put your name on the door yet! There may be a few men left on their ship. Look, their bird is nested right over there.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: The Morrigan! What is she doing there? That's my ship, friend. Begging your pardon, but I must go fetch her back from those louts.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Wait. I can hardly let you do that alone.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: Help me if you can then.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Keep your wits about you, Shay. Criminals are everywhere, and most of them look just like law-abiding citizens.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: And they've been harassing the people who've nursed me back to health.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Sounds like good folks.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: They are. Perhaps you know them? Barry and Cassidy Finnegan.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: I've never met them, but I knew their son... Careful now... These ruffians can be anywhere. You can draw them out by making noise.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: Oh, I've got something better than that...

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Well! You seem more than capable of taking care of this matter. Tell you what, I shall find a crew for your vessel in case you have to leave post-haste.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: She's a fine ship. And true to my word, I've found a crew for her. I did leave one position unfilled, though. Tell me, Shay, do you have a first mate?

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: He's... long gone.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Then I apply for the post, Captain!

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: Welcome aboard.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: As your first mate, may I suggest our next destination? The Colonel will be expecting me to report back.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Shay
en: My thoughts exactly. Colonel Monro said he'd be in Albany.

scene: A Long Walk and a Short Drop
speaker: Gist
en: Splendid!

speaker: Haytham
en: Shay Cormac. I hear you are the Templars' new don of Precursor archaeology.

speaker: Shay
en: I'm no expert, sir. I just witnessed what the Assassins can do with those damned sites...

speaker: Haytham
en: I have spent years investigating Precursor leads. Tell me what you've seen.

speaker: Shay
en: Well, I know both the Assassins and Templars are looking for Pieces of Eden. Powerful weapons, mind-controlling Apples, but this time it's different. We haven't found an apple, but... a tree. These Temples hold the earth together like roots. Disturb them, and Haiti falls or... Lisbon. Or any other place the Manuscript shows.

speaker: Haytham
en: And the Assassins are blindly interfering with these structures?

speaker: Shay
en: Aye. And if we don't stop them, they'll continue destroying cities.

speaker: Haytham
en: I see... We have intelligence of Assassin activity near Louisbourg fortress. We'll be meeting with a Royal Navy officer, James Cook. He recently gained a commission that could be strategically valuable. Gist has the charts.

speaker: Shay
en: Very well. I'll depart shortly.

speaker: Haytham
en: Colonel Monro spoke highly of you, Shay. He was convinced you could become the best among us. I expect you will not disappoint.

speaker: Shay
en: I don't plan to, sir.

speaker: Shay
en: Gist, do you know why the Grand Master is so interested in Captain Cook?

speaker: Gist
en: Well, sir, he's very intelligent and ambitious. His knowledge of seamanship is second-to-none! And if I trust my favourite barmaid in Halifax, he also just became captain of his own man-o-war. He's also an expert at deciphering secret codes... A man with such a skill is certainly an asset to our cause.

speaker: Shay
en: The kind of fellow we should welcome in the Order, then?

speaker: Gist
en: Well... He's a friend of mine, but the man has an annoying habit of strict honesty and a total lack of anything resembling guile. Makes it a little hard to keep secret business secret, especially when his mathematical brain is clever at cracking codes. Consider him an ally, but watch what you say around him.

speaker: Shay
en: Duly noted.

speaker: Gist
en: I've heard Louisbourg could be a lynchpin in the war. If the Royal Navy can take that fort, it'll be clear sailing down the Saint Lawrence.

speaker: Shay
en: Then onto Quebec and Montreal... The tide is turning.

speaker: Gist
en: General Wolfe will give that craven Montcalm a right thrashing.

speaker: Shay
en: I've been looking forward to that since Fort William Henry.

speaker: Gist
en: With this bloody war over, we'll finally bring order to this damned continent!

speaker: Shay
en: I fear it will take more than that, friend.

speaker: Gist
en: There she is! The HMS Pembroke. Captain James Cook's ship.

speaker: Shay
en: She's a beauty.

speaker: Gist
en: Man-o-war. Fully armed. We should bring the Morrigan alongside, Master Kenway will surely be waiting.

speaker: Cook
en: Welcome aboard, gentlemen.

speaker: Gist
en: Good to see you again, Captain.

speaker: Haytham
en: Captain Shay Cormac. Captain James Cook.

speaker: Cook
en: Pleased to make your acquaintance.

speaker: Shay
en: Pleasure's mine, sir.

speaker: Haytham
en: Captain Cook uncovered a rather distressing stratagem, which I fear confirms our own intelligence.

speaker: Cook
en: Indeed, as we speak, a Royal Navy fleet is on its way to Louisbourg. However, the French have drawn up a preemptive strike against it. If they launch this attack...

speaker: Haytham
en: Obviously we cannot allow that to happen. Gentlemen, the Battle of Louisbourg could very well be the turning point which will finally bring this war to a close.

speaker: Shay
en: I don't know about you, but I've had enough of war.

speaker: Cook
en: Then may I suggest you take the wheel, Captain Cormac? I think you might enjoy piloting a vessel with real... firepower.

speaker: Shay
en: I believe I shall, Captain.

speaker: Cook
en: Wolfe, and lead the three divisions of the Royal Navy.

speaker: Shay
en: Who's their commander?

speaker: Cook
en: Major General Amherst himself, back from .

speaker: Haytham
en: You take an interest in the war, Shay?

speaker: Shay
en: Wouldn't want to disappoint you, sir.

speaker: Gist
en: Enemy ahead!

speaker: Crew member
en: They're hit!

speaker: Shay
en: Damn it! We cannot let any through!

speaker: Cook
en: It is imperative we stop those ships, Captain. The outcome of the war may depend on it.

speaker: Haytham
en: Make good use of your own mortars, Shay. They will prove crucial if we are to succeed.

speaker: Cook
en: Dear God! Fireships! Should they break through they will devastate our fleet!

speaker: Shay
en: Then we better not let that happen.

speaker: Gist
en: I recognize that vessel, sir. It's the Experto Crede.

speaker: Haytham
en: Adéwalé! How fortunate he is that we have other priorities.

speaker: Shay
en: Agreed, we have to get rid of those fireships.

speaker: Crew member
en: More fireships!

speaker: Cook
en: I believe Master Kenway is correct, Captain. Mortars would prove most advantageous right now.

speaker: Gist
en: Another wave of fireships, Captain! We should fire our mortars, Captain. We're right in their path! We have to sink that fireship or get out of their way!

speaker: Gist
en: More enemy ships, sir! And more fireships!

speaker: Cook
en: This is hopeless. Perhaps it would be wiser to fall back.

speaker: Shay
en: War and wisdom don't always mix, Captain. This isn't over yet, lads! Man the cannons!

speaker: Cook
en: There's the Royal Navy! We cleared the way just in time, Captain Cormac.

speaker: Gist
en: The tide of war is turning!

speaker: Shay
en: That was quite the crack, wasn't it?

speaker: Haytham
en: It is too soon for celebrations. Adéwalé is still out there.

speaker: Shay
en: I'm sure we'll get another turn to dance with him, Master Kenway.

speaker: Cook
en: Master Cormac! To what do I owe the pleasure?

speaker: Shay
en: I was stopping to restock my ship when I heard the talented Captain Cook was here. Could we have a word?

speaker: Cook
en: At your service, as always.

speaker: Shay
en: I'm looking for a man. Captain Louis-Joseph Gaultier, Chevalier de la Vérendrye.

speaker: Cook
en: The explorer. I have heard of him, and his illustrious family.

speaker: Shay
en: I must see him.

speaker: Cook
en: Ah, send him my regards! Or not... He sailed east a few days ago on a heading to Anticosti.

speaker: Shay
en: Hmm... Indeed.

speaker: Cook
en: I would advise caution.

speaker: Shay
en: Oh, I've been there before.

speaker: Cook
en: Then I bid you good fortune. I will be sailing past , should you require further assistance.

speaker: Shay
en: Much obliged.

speaker: Gist
en: The Grand Master is pleased, Shay. What you did in New York... Well, it's only a matter of time now before order is restored.

speaker: Shay
en: New York was never "orderly", Gist... With Hope gone, perhaps...

speaker: Gist
en: It couldn't have been easy for you, my lad. But you did what you had to do.

speaker: Shay
en: I keep telling myself that...

speaker: Gist
en: We're almost rid of the Assassins in New York, and it's not as if the hellcat didn't try to make you wear a pine overcoat. You had no other choice.

speaker: Shay
en: I chose to cast my lot with the Templars.

speaker: Gist
en: And we are glad you did, Shay. Who knows, had you not, you might have found yourself at the end of Master Kenway's blade.

speaker: Shay
en: Or yours!

speaker: Gist
en: That's the spirit! Look Shay, by killing Hope, you not only saved yourself and half of New York from the Assassins' poisons, you also learned the path we must take next. Now our task is simple: prevent a group of paper-skull killers from destroying another city. All in a day's work.

speaker: Shay
en: A long day, Gist.

speaker: Gist
en: Not to be insensitive, sir, but what did you learn from the departed damsel?

speaker: Shay
en: That she's cleverer than I even thought. Her whole ruse was to give Liam time to get back to Chevalier. They must have already set sail to a new Precursor site.

speaker: Gist
en: Determined to the end! I must say, I admire the misguided lass.

speaker: Shay
en: I don't. The Assassins won't stop their mad quest. They are desperate to find a Piece of Eden... Especially now that half of their Brotherhood is dead.
