speaker: Gist
en: There may be an alternate route to the west!

speaker: Shay
en: Anticosti is famed for its shipwrecks. They likely believe no one would venture into such dangerous waters.

speaker: Gist
en: None but fools and madmen, perhaps? Watch out for those icebergs, Captain.

speaker: Captain
en: This man stands before you in disgrace. Greed has corrupted his character and put our very livelihood in peril. We bow to no laws save our own. And those laws decree that any betrayal is met with the gravest punishment. Let this be a reminder! Obey the code! Now back to your posts!

speaker: Gang member 1
en: Mills deserved to swing. This place would be overrun with redcoats if we hadn't found him out.

speaker: Gang member 2
en: Makes you wonder how many other rats riddle this island.

speaker: Gang member 3
en: Only a matter of time before someone paid the price. Captain's been spitting bile ever since the Frenchman left.

speaker: Gang member 2
en: Never trusted that fellow.

speaker: Captain
en: These documents are nothing but blasted symbols and nonsense. That French devil was always one for secrets. But he has found the site of a great treasure. I am sure of it.

speaker: Shay
en: Better head back to the Morrigan.

speaker: Shay
en: Blast! She's been found!

speaker: Crew member
en: Taking heavy damage, sir!

speaker: Gist
en: Hold fast! We wait for the Captain!

speaker: Gist
en: We must leave, Shay!

speaker: Shay
en: You'll have no argument from me! Set sails! Make haste!

speaker: Gist
en: We're overmatched, sir!

speaker: Gist
en: The Royal Navy!

speaker: Shay
en: I still can't get used to that. King George's men will take care of those pirates! We've got our own battles to fight.

speaker: Shay
en: That was a far closer escape than I'm comfortable with, but we have what we came for.

speaker: Gist
en: Then we know where de la Vérendrye's ships are headed?

speaker: Shay
en: Not quite. But we have the means to find out. We'll need Cook to interpret these maps.

speaker: Gist
en: Then we should set sail for the coast of Newfoundland.

speaker: Gist
en: Master Kenway.

speaker: Shay
en: De la Vérendrye's dead. I have the coordinates. I know where the Assassins are going.

speaker: Haytham
en: Then, let us make haste.

speaker: Shay
en: Do you think Achilles and Liam have found the Precursor site?

speaker: Haytham
en: The world is still standing. If they uncovered it, they have not yet set the earth in motion.

speaker: Gist
en: How gentlemanly of them.

speaker: Haytham
en: There should still be time. Master Gist, stay here. I shall accompany Shay.

speaker: Gist
en: Sir? With respect, are you sure that's wise?

speaker: Haytham
en: As Grand Master, I must investigate this Precursor matter to the end. And witness the death of Achilles' Brotherhood.

speaker: Shay
en: If the Assassins do trigger an earthquake, at least there's few around to suffer.

speaker: Haytham
en: I have no intention of letting your former colleagues destroy a Precursor site, regardless.

speaker: Shay
en: This would be beautiful if it wasn't so damned cold.

speaker: Haytham
en: Tread carefully... Some of this ice is rather thin.

speaker: Shay
en: That's a hefty crew Achilles brought.

speaker: Haytham
en: I doubt he expects all of them to survive these conditions.

speaker: Shay
en: That's bleak. But we're still outnumbered. Let's keep a low profile, avoid unnecessary fights.

speaker: Haytham
en: Your Assassins would scarce recognize you. Come, let us enter their parlor.

speaker: Haytham
en: Go on, Shay! I will find another way.

speaker: Liam
en: Is this the Apple?

speaker: Achilles
en: No! Don't touch anything. Shay was right.

speaker: Liam
en: What would he know?

speaker: Achilles
en: More than me, apparently.

speaker: Shay
en: Finally you understand, Achilles. This is a structure to hold the world together, not a weapon to control it. This whole calamity could have been avoided if you'd only listened to me!

speaker: Achilles
en: Disrespectful to the end.

speaker: Haytham
en: Yes, we've been working on that...

speaker: Liam
en: Right or wrong, Shay, you betrayed the Brotherhood, Achilles, and me.

speaker: Shay
en: Says the man who shot me in the back.

speaker: Liam
en: At the Homestead? That was Chevalier. I don't miss!

speaker: Achilles
en: Liam, don't!

speaker: Shay
en: Did you have to bring that damned Manuscript and Box all the way out here, Liam?

speaker: Liam
en: The Precursor box is safe, Shay. Chevalier took care of that. You'll never find it!

speaker: Liam
en: I found Hope's body, Shay!

speaker: Shay
en: I'm sorry!

speaker: Liam
en: Was it you? Tell me!

speaker: Shay
en: I had to!...

speaker: Liam
en: No... You chose to!

speaker: Liam
en: Give up, Shay! Your luck has run out! A cold grave awaits you! You won't get out of here, you bastard! How could you do this to us? How could you kill Hope?!

speaker: Liam
en: That was... lucky.

speaker: Shay
en: How many times do I have to tell you, Liam? I make my own luck.

speaker: Liam
en: And how'd you do that, you bastard? You broke the Assassins. Betrayed... everyone you knew... You sided with... our worst enemies... And for what?!

speaker: Shay
en: To save the world.

speaker: Liam
en: I hope that world... is a good one.

speaker: Shay
en: No!

speaker: Haytham
en: Why not?

speaker: Shay
en: Achilles is harmless now! A Mentor with no followers. What kind of world are we making if we cannot show mercy? Besides, he understands what these Precursor sites are now. Without him, the Assassins may continue their search.

speaker: Haytham
en: Valid points.

speaker: Haytham
en: Never forget what has happened here.

speaker: Achilles
en: I won't... But the world will.

speaker: Shay
en: So what happens now?

speaker: Haytham
en: Master Gist will be in charge of eradicating any remaining traces of the Assassins. Master Weeks and the others will assist him, of course.

speaker: Shay
en: Achilles has lost everything. He won't dare leave his Homestead.

speaker: Haytham
en: He won't... Shay, although our search for Precursor sites is at an end, I want that Box. You will find it for the Templar Order, and for me.

speaker: Shay
en: It could be anywhere in the world by now... It may take years to find it.

speaker: Haytham
en: It may take you a lifetime. Are you up for the challenge?

speaker: Haytham
en: Good.

speaker: Liam
en: It's so grim about the Homestead now that Miss Abigail and little Connor have passed.

speaker: Shay
en: Aye. I've seen Achilles crying.

speaker: Liam
en: Why shouldn't he?

speaker: Shay
en: It's just that... he doesn't look sad. He looks furious. It's unsettling.

speaker: Liam
en: He's struggling with the loss. We all are.

speaker: Shay
en: I know. But it's been months... and we've done little but search for this blasted Manuscript and box!

speaker: Liam
en: Le Chasseur has a lead on the box. We're to meet him and Chevalier in Saint John's.

speaker: Shay
en: Chevalier, too? No hope of cheering me up, then. When Achilles said whoever had the artifacts could access sites of great power, what did he mean?

speaker: Liam
en: I'm not sure I understand it myself, Shay. I had a long talk with Adéwalé about that. He believes the box can be activated to, well, project words or images...

speaker: Shay
en: Like a ?

speaker: Liam
en: What do you mean?

speaker: Shay
en: You know, the magic lantern shows Father Connolly put on in the church basement. The box had a candle in it, I think. He put these little glass plates in front. Then we'd see images projected on the wall, like cathedrals in Rome, bright and near as big as life!

speaker: Liam
en: Ah yeah. I suppose it is... Except that it interprets the strange language of the manuscript too. If the plate were of a banner in Latin, we'd see it in English.

speaker: Shay
en: How is that possible?

speaker: Liam
en: Who knows. I fear we might never truly understand how any of the Pieces of Eden work.

speaker: Shay
en: Where in the world has the most beautiful girls?

speaker: Liam
en: I suppose it depends on your vision of beauty. A damsel from Corfu and one from are as different as chalk and cheese but, both can be lovely.

speaker: Shay
en: You see, opinions like that give a man a reputation for wisdom.

speaker: Liam
en: Yeah, thank you.

speaker: Shay
en: I would have just said Havana. The girls there have lusty buttocks and bosoms and feel no shame in putting them on display! But that's no slight against our lasses from home.

speaker: Liam
en: I suppose...

speaker: Shay
en: I think Galway has the nicest ones, fair and modest, always willing to spot you a penny for an ale.

speaker: Liam
en: You don't say.

speaker: Shay
en: And then there's the maids I met in Lisbon. Destined for the convent they were, dark-eyed and kindly-dispositioned. If only I spoke Portuguese... Not that we spent much of our nights talking.

speaker: Liam
en: Opinions like that give a man an entirely different reputation.

speaker: Liam
en: We're almost there, Captain. Le Chasseur will be expecting us.

speaker: Shay
en: And Chevalier.

speaker: Liam
en: Ah, a small price to pay for a lead on the Precursor box.

speaker: Shay
en: Chevalier! What happened to your vessel?

speaker: Chevalier
en: I got myself into a bit of a scrape. Sent three ships in all hands to their watery graves, Le Gerfaut nearly followed them down.

speaker: Shay
en: I trust your fate has been better, Le Chasseur.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Indeed. My sources informed me that Samuel Smith has searched far and wide, looking for answers on how to make that strange box work. He just returned from Europe.

speaker: Shay
en: Where is he now?

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Refitting his schooner. If you hurry, you can catch him... there.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Oh, remember those blueprints? Well, I had an engineer build that marvelous weapon for your ship. Master Puckle's gun fires more shots than an artillery brigade, and twice as fast.

speaker: Shay
en: Many thanks!

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Anything for my hooded friends.

speaker: Shay
en: Captain?

speaker: Chevalier
en: I will join you on this voyage.

speaker: Shay
en: Then shall we, gentlemen?

speaker: Chevalier
en: You are in a jovial mood, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Why shouldn't I be? I have a new weapon, and will soon have the chance to use it. Besides, Templars are usually well guarded, and I'm sure that Smith fellow is no exception.

speaker: Liam
en: I also took the liberty of ordering some improvements. The Morrigan now has a ram that can cut through ice itself.

speaker: Chevalier
en: I have heard of such technology but never witnessed its operation.

speaker: Liam
en: What about Smith then? Is he close by?

speaker: Shay
en: Aye, he sails these very waters. And he may have the Precursor box.

speaker: Liam
en: Then let's find him!

speaker: Shay
en: There he is!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Most fortunate timing. Lady Luck never ceases to smile on you.

speaker: Shay
en: He's seen us. Give chase!

speaker: Chevalier
en: But hold your fire! We must not damage the box or risk losing it to the sea.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Careful, you simpleton! You will destroy the box!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Can't this bucket go any faster?

speaker: Shay
en: At least my ship is still sea-worthy, Chevalier.

speaker: Liam
en: Our target's a smart man, but out of his element here.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Samuel Smith is the Templars' treasurer. What he's doing in these waters is beyond me.

speaker: Shay
en: Maybe he came here to meet someone... Or ran into your pirates. He's refitting his ship, so something must have happened.

speaker: Chevalier
en: If one of my allies attacked him, I would have known about it.

speaker: Liam
en: Well he's back from a long voyage. Now's our chance to get him.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Smith controls most of the Templars' wealth, doesn't he? With him out of the way...

speaker: Shay
en: Washington entrusted the Precursor box to him. He probably still has it.

speaker: Liam
en: Shay's right. The box comes first.

speaker: Shay
en: So we can't sink him. We'll have to board his ship, or force him to beach.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Enough! This is not a game, cabbage farmer!

speaker: Crewman
en: We can't risk loosing the Precursor box, Capt'n!

speaker: Liam
en: Look, Captain! He's cutting through the ice!

speaker: Chevalier
en: It seems you are not the only one equipped with such a ram, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Let us hope ours fares just as well.

speaker: Liam
en: It worked! The way is clear!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Once more your fortune holds. But do not waste time congratulating yourself. Smith is getting away.

speaker: Liam
en: It's an ambush!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Envoyez ces diables en enfer! (Send these devils to hell!) Smith must not escape!

speaker: Liam
en: I don't see Smith's ship!

speaker: Shay
en: Let's get rid of these distractions first. We'll find him.

speaker: Liam
en: There's Smith! He's moving again!

speaker: Chevalier
en: No doubt he hoped to be a spectator to your demise.

speaker: Shay
en: I'm glad to disappoint him. And he's still within reach.

speaker: Liam
en: What wickedness is this?

speaker: Chevalier
en: Another Templar tactic. They can cover whole stretches of oceans with their flames.

speaker: Liam
en: Careful, Shay. We could be burnt to cinders.

speaker: Shay
en: It's nothing more than a last desperate throw of the dice. He knows we have him.

speaker: Liam
en: And now we know where he was headed. The bastard has an encampment here.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Follow him on land! Do not even think of firing the ship's weapons near that precious box!

speaker: Shay
en: I'll take care of this.

speaker: Smith
en: This will be your end, Assassin! You will regret this! Think of what you're doing, Assassin! Your Brotherhood is using you!

speaker: Smith
en: Kill him! Somebody stop him! What are you waiting for? Finish him now!

speaker: Smith
en: This cannot be... No! Do you even know what that is?

speaker: Shay
en: An ancient artifact, a treasure from Those Who Came Before.

speaker: Smith
en: Yes... It matters not... Some of the greatest scientific minds of all Europe could not... make it... work...

speaker: Shay
en: Now all I need is the Manuscript and all shall be revealed.

speaker: Gist
en: Pirates! We've found them, captain!

speaker: Shay
en: They should have kept to warmer climates. Prepare for battle! Here they come! Don't let them outflank us!

speaker: Shay
en: Well done, men! But beware the second ship, she will seek to avenge her comrade.

speaker: Gist
en: Aye, sir! She does seem rather upset.

speaker: Shay
en: Keep out of her way! We'll be smashed to splinters!

speaker: Violet
en: The Royal Palace at Versailles... Louis the Sixteenth and Marie Antoinette in residence.

speaker: Berg
en: Such decadence.

speaker: Violet
en: Good luck, numbskull.

speaker: Franklin
en: Ah, Shay. You certainly look prepared to meet royalty! Perhaps King Louis himself will grant you an audience.

speaker: Shay
en: I doubt even these breeches will get me into the King's chambers. Besides, I'm only here to see a business acquaintance.

speaker: Franklin
en: Yes, I heard a group of merchants would be here today. They might come see my scientific demonstration later!

speaker: Shay
en: They really should, they might learn something. Though I wouldn't count on their being present. I take my leave. Thank you again, Master Franklin.

speaker: Shay
en: Now to find Charles... and that damned box.

speaker: Shay
en: That's him! Charles Dorian.

speaker: Guard
en: Sorry sir, the palace is closed to visitors at the moment. Please return tomorrow.

speaker: Shay
en: But I'm supposed to be in a meeting right now.

speaker: Guard
en: Then you should already be inside. Come back and sell your wool tomorrow.

speaker: Shay
en: Lucky for him, I can find another way in.

speaker: Élise
en: Did you see their faces when we stole those apples?

speaker: Arno
en: I'm Arno.

speaker: Élise
en: Élise.

speaker: Arno
en: I'm here with my father.

speaker: Élise
en: So am I. He has important business with the king.

speaker: Arno
en: What should we do now?

speaker: Charles
en: Gentlemen, I will protect this artifact with my very life. Arno? Where have you gone? My son, Arno... Perhaps you have seen him? Have you seen a little boy around? I'm looking for my son. Arno! Where are you? Arno? Arno? Stop playing, Arno. Time to come out.

speaker: Charles
en: You! You're the traitor.

speaker: Shay
en: I'm just finishing old business.

speaker: Charles
en: Old... Connor and his Assassins... The American Revolution undid your Templar business.

speaker: Shay
en: Then perhaps we shall start a revolution of our own.

speaker: Shay
en: Uphold the principles of our order and all that for which we stand. Never share our secrets nor divulge the true nature of our work. Do so until death - whatever the cost. This is my new creed. I am Shay Patrick Cormac, Templar of the Colonial... of the American rite. I am an older man now, and perhaps wiser. A war and a revolution have ended, and another is about to begin. May the Father of Understanding guide us all.

speaker: Juhani
en: What is this?

speaker: Violet
en: A glitch in the memories... There seems to be more data. Okay, numbskull, I can't pull you out of the chair right now. You'll just have to see this through... This is bizarre... These memories seem to take place some 20 years after the one we just saw.

speaker: Juhani
en: Are you certain?

speaker: Violet
en: Positive. This means... Shay must have survived that fall!

speaker: Juhani
en: If he is the man I believe him to be, then he has... Keep going.

speaker: Violet
en: The data is fragmented... This memory is incomplete... Let me see what I can do. Listen up. We need to find out what Shay's up to. This memory's gonna look a little rough, but I'm like ninety percent sure sequencing this memory won't kill you.

speaker: Violet
en: Alright, numbskull, we don't know where Shay is, or what he's doing there. So keep your eyes and ears open.

speaker: Juhani
en: I want to know the reason Shay came to this place.

speaker: Violet
en: You heard the man. Let's move!

speaker: Criminal 1
en: Et alors? Vous l'avez trouvé? (So? Did you find him?)

speaker: Criminal 2
en: Oui, Benjamin Franklin est à Notre-Dame. Si on se magne, on devrait le rattraper. (Yes, Benjamin Franklin is at Notre-Dame. If we hurry up, we can catch him.)

speaker: Criminal 3
en: Arrêtes de vous branler! Allons-y! (Stop playing with yourselves! Let's go!)

speaker: Juhani
en: Benjamin Franklin...That's who Shay is after.

speaker: Violet
en: Franklin traveled to England and France. And that guy said Notre-Dame... Shay must be in Paris! Time to show me what you got!

speaker: Juhani
en: Eliminate the threat. Protect Franklin.

speaker: Criminal 4
en: Il est là! Attrapez-le! (Over there! Get him!)

speaker: Franklin
en: Help! Somebody help!

speaker: Criminal 4
en: Il ne nous échappera pas cette fois! (He's not getting away from us this time!)

speaker: Violet
en: Shit!

speaker: Juhani
en: What happened?

speaker: Violet
en: That's all the data we have. We can't explore this memory further... for now. Shay couldn't have died then appeared in France twenty years later. We're missing something. Shay's memories are scattered in chunks throughout the Cloud, the servers are messed up from the virus, so we can't access all of Shay's life at once.

speaker: Christopher
en: Damn the Devil! What happened here?

speaker: Shay
en: Kesegowaase!

speaker: Christopher
en: Then we are too late.

speaker: Shay
en: No. Fort Frederick is nearby, I'm sure the Colonel can hold it.

speaker: Christopher
en: You heard the Captain, lads! Make haste!

speaker: Shay
en: Keep her safe while I'm gone, Gist.

speaker: Christopher
en: Aye, Captain.

speaker: Gang member 1
en: Get out here!

speaker: Civilian 1
en: This is my home! I'm staying!

speaker: Gang member 2
en: Come out, come out, wherever you are!

speaker: Civilian 2
en: Oh no, I'm staying in... Just like Colonel Monro said. Yes sir... just like he said.

speaker: Gang member 3
en: What you doin' out and about?

speaker: Civilian 3
en: I should have gone to the fort...

speaker: Gang member 4
en: Where do you think you're going?

speaker: Civilian 4
en: Get away from me!

speaker: Soldiers
en: This is it, boy! Inside, quick! Attack! Atttaaaaaack! Rrrrraaaahh! AAAaaaaaahhhhh! Mwrrrraaaaaah!!

speaker: George
en: Barricade that breach!

speaker: Soldier 1
en: Yes, sir!

speaker: Soldier 2
en: Do not let more in! Attack! Attack!

speaker: Soldier 1
en: More ammunition, sir!

speaker: George
en: Reinforce the south wall!

speaker: Soldier 2
en: Fire at will!

speaker: Soldier 1
en: They're everywhere!

speaker: George
en: Man your positions!

speaker: Shay
en: This is Kesegowaase's work, isn't it?

speaker: George
en: I believe it is, but I have not yet seen the devil.

speaker: George
en: The Manuscript. You

speaker: Shay
en: Keep it safe. Bring it to the Morrigan. That's an order.

speaker: George
en: Who are you to give me orders? I outrank you.

speaker: Shay
en: I'm not part of your army, Colonel. I'll take care of the defenses until you get back.

speaker: Shay
en: Kesegowaase!

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Burn! Templar dog! Do you truly believe you can best me, traitor?

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: We trained you well... traitor.

speaker: Shay
en: Kesegowaase... It didn't have to be this way.

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: It did. You are an enemy. Achilles will see you dead.

speaker: Shay
en: What he's doing is wrong!

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Who are you to judge? The Templars will fail. You will fail. Monro... is already... dead.

speaker: Shay
en: What do you mean?

speaker: Kesegowaase
en: Liam...

speaker: Shay
en: Argh!

speaker: Soldier 3
en: The Colonel was heading for the docks!

speaker: Soldier 4
en: A huge man with an axe was chasing the Colonel!

speaker: Soldiers
en: Put out the flames before the fire spreads! The Colonel! He's trapped inside! Help! Save the Colonel!

speaker: George
en: The Manuscript... An Assassin took it...

speaker: Shay
en: Liam. I'll get it back. I swear it!

speaker: George
en: Shay!

speaker: Haytham
en: Do you swear to uphold the principles of our order and all that for which we stand?

speaker: Shay
en: I do.

speaker: Haytham
en: And never to share our secrets nor divulge the true nature of our work?

speaker: Shay
en: I do.

speaker: Haytham
en: And to do so from now until death—whatever the cost?

speaker: Shay
en: I do.

speaker: Haytham
en: Then we welcome you into our fold, brother. You are now a Templar, harbinger of a New World. May the Father of Understanding guide us.

speaker: All
en: May the Father of Understanding guide us.

speaker: Gist
en: There she is, captain! The Storm Fortress!

speaker: Shay
en: The rumors did not embellish the truth. She's a leviathan.

speaker: Gist
en: She's firing mortars, captain!

speaker: Shay
en: We must get closer to the beast if we're to bring her down!

speaker: Gist
en: We should avoid her broadsides, captain! She's much too powerful there!

speaker: Gist
en: Dear god! We'll be overrun!

speaker: Shay
en: We've beaten the odds before, Gist. We shall do so again.

speaker: Gist
en: Fighting in this storm is madness! I can't distinguish friend from foe!

speaker: Shay
en: Neither can they. With any luck they'll obliterate one another.

speaker: Shay
en: Where to?

speaker: Liam
en: Wherever Templar affairs lead us.

speaker: Shay
en: Liam, it's not like you to set out without a plan.

speaker: Liam
en: Plan or no plan, we choose our own battlefield. And hey, are we not most at ease when we're at sea?

speaker: Shay
en: Right you are. Let's set sail.

speaker: Liam
en: We only have one lead, Shay. Let's hope it brings us closer to the artifacts.

speaker: Shay
en: So Achilles tasked you with this mission?

speaker: Liam
en: No. He tasked me to task you. You need to find what was stolen from Mackandal, Shay. You have to recover the Precursor box and Manuscript. This is your mission.

speaker: Shay
en: And what's yours?

speaker: Liam
en: Watch your arse.

speaker: Shay
en: Achilles doesn't really trust me, does he?

speaker: Liam
en: Give it time, Shay. Do this for him—for us—and you'll do much more than earn his trust.

speaker: Shay
en: Liam, do you know what Achilles writes about? I see him in his office all the time, bent over his papers.

speaker: Liam
en: He keeps records and accounts, studies what little is known of the Pieces of Eden... And of course he corresponds with Assassins on other continents.

speaker: Shay
en: Of course? Liam, you can be a right horse's arse when it comes to assuming everyone knows the same as you.

speaker: Liam
en: I cannot help if Achilles wants me to be familiar with our counterparts in Europe and elsewhere.

speaker: Shay
en: Said like his favorite son.

speaker: Liam
en: Connor is his favorite, and only son.

speaker: Shay
en: Then Achilles' heir. Connor may inherit the house, but you'll be Mentor.

speaker: Liam
en: We'll see.

speaker: Shay
en: Whatever you say, Prince Regent of the Assassins.

speaker: Liam
en: You call me that again and I'll throw you in the ocean!

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Trust me, you will sell those lobsters by the ton in France. Ah, the cabbage farmer returns. About time. We have a lead on the curious manuscript.

speaker: Shay
en: I'd be surprised if you could read it.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: No one can read it, imbécile (you silly man). This is why the Templars are taking so long with it. But one of our allies has caught a glimpse of their work.

speaker: Shay
en: A pirate?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: A spy who works with the pirates. We set sail for Anticosti. That should prove a good test for this floating cesspit you call a ship.

speaker: Shay
en: How trustworthy are the pirates?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: I consider them brothers, Shay. When the time comes, they will lend aid and help us fight the Templars. If only the Rosbif would realize the Templars were pulling their strings.

speaker: Shay
en: Are the Templars truly in control in the Colonies?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Not quite, but their influence reaches far and wide.

speaker: Shay
en: And what about the spy we're meeting?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: You need not worry about Le Chasseur. He is loyal to the Brotherhood. As it happens, he also has "friends" in both the French and English fleets, and he knows more about what goes on in these parts than you can ever hope to learn.

speaker: Shay
en: So Liam, what can you tell me about Adéwalé? You obviously admire the man.

speaker: Liam
en: Aye. I had the honor of working with him once. I've never known anyone who'd done so much for our cause... but it's much more than that.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Adéwalé was already une légende (a legend) before joining the Brotherhood. He was a pirate—the scourge of the West Indies!—rubbing elbows with the likes of Blackbeard, Woodes Rogers, and Calico Jack Rackham.

speaker: Shay
en: Calico who?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Oh, read a book, will you?

speaker: Liam
en: About 20 years ago, Adéwalé intercepted a Templar convoy and stole a mysterious package. He traveled to Port-au-Prince, and entrusted it to a woman he believed was loyal to our cause.

speaker: Shay
en: Let me guess, she wasn't?

speaker: Liam
en: Ah, she was. Very much so. The package eventually found its way to François Mackandal, Mentor of the Haitian Brotherhood.

speaker: Shay
en: What is it? The package, I mean.

speaker: Liam
en: The very box we're seeking. We still have little idea what this vessel is capable of. Why don't we set the Morrigan against a quarry of her caliber?

speaker: Shay
en: You just want to test I can shoot straight, don't you schoolmaster?

speaker: Liam
en: Well, if the lesson fits...

speaker: Liam
en: There, Captain! An English vessel, and she looks to be in trouble.

speaker: Shay
en: That's fine indeed. Perhaps we should aid her journey to the bottom of the sea.

speaker: Liam
en: Let's not be too hasty. She's full of Crown cargo. Take a look through your spyglass and see for yourself.

speaker: Shay
en: A pretty sight. I say this is a good day to lighten King George's pockets.

speaker: Liam
en: Be careful. A few shots should be enough to cripple her. Too much damage and she'll go down with all souls. And all spoils.

speaker: Shay
en: We can board and loot her before the crew knows what hit them.

speaker: Liam
en: Captain, hold your fire! We don't want to sink her! Now's the time, let's board her! Show them what's for, Captain!

speaker: Shay
en: Come on, men! The spoils are ours! For the Morrigan!

speaker: Liam
en: The sea between here and Anticosti is rough, Captain. We should strengthen the Morrigan before going any further. There's a harbormaster stationed nearby. We can spend our new wealth on improvements.

speaker: Shay
en: I didn't realize there was a Brotherhood in Haiti.

speaker: Liam
en: Yes, François Mackandal is their mentor. He gathers many of his Assassins from the Maroons.

speaker: Shay
en: Those are escaped slaves and their children, right?

speaker: Liam
en: They are. It's a shame though. They escaped terrible conditions only to be killed in that earthquake.

speaker: Shay
en: But... Haiti's a French colony, no?

speaker: Liam
en: Aye, it is.

speaker: Shay
en: And here, the Assassins are helping King Louis. But in Haiti, the French own the slaves who are set free by the Assassins.

speaker: Liam
en: Our struggle is beyond political borders, Shay. Anticosti shouldn't be far. Keep us on course, Captain.

speaker: Shay
en: Is this the place? I see nothing but fishermen and their gear.

speaker: Liam
en: Aye, Percé and fishing go hand-in-hand, but it'll serve our purposes well enough. The French fished these waters first, but King George is laying claim to more every year. The locals are caught in the middle.

speaker: Liam
en: You'd better borrow some coin. Bartering with an empty purse won't get you very far.

speaker: Liam
en: We should resume course to Anticosti, Captain.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Indeed. Le Chasseur is waiting for us.

speaker: Liam
en: The sea between here and Anticosti is rough, Captain, but the Morrigan seems sturdy enough for the challenge.

speaker: Crew member
en: Ships ahoy!

speaker: Liam
en: More fishermen from Percé.

speaker: Crew member
en: Enemy ships!

speaker: Shay
en: They're sinking the fishing boats!

speaker: Liam
en: They must believe those fishermen strayed into their waters.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: These cowards must pay!

speaker: Shay
en: And would you look at that, standing right in our way to Anticosti. What say you we sink every last one of them?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: For once, I find myself agreeing with you, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Stranger things have happened.

speaker: Shay
en: That's the last of them.

speaker: Liam
en: Then let us go on. We're not too far from Anticosti Island now.

speaker: Shay
en: Will your friend the spy be waiting for us?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Yes. I hope Le Chasseur has more information about the Manuscript.

speaker: Shay
en: Maybe he'll have the whole thing figured out for us.

speaker: Liam
en: And maybe I'm Emperor of Rome.

speaker: Shay
en: Ave, Caesar! Salt air, open skies... A man out on the ocean is as free as a man can be. What do you say, Liam?

speaker: Liam
en: We're out here for a reason, Shay. Mind your duty.

speaker: Shay
en: Well what's the point of freedom if you cannot breathe deep and enjoy it?

speaker: Liam
en: The Templars stick to this continent like tar. I won't feel liberated until we pry them off.

speaker: Shay
en: Seems to me we should just talk to them like men instead of skulking around.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: And would you smile and wish them a good day as they lay their boot on your neck?

speaker: Shay
en: Of course not.

speaker: Liam
en: They're murdering bastards who want to control the world and everyone in it. Never forget.

speaker: Shay
en: And we have nothing in common with that, of course.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: There it is. Anticosti. Le Chasseur should be there... And with any luck he will know where to find that Manuscript.

speaker: Liam
en: Dock the ship here, Captain. We've arrived at Anticosti Island.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Go on ahead, Shay. We will meet you at the fort.

speaker: Guard 1
en: The rum here is terrible!

speaker: Guard 2
en: Let me see... That's not rum, it's (water of life)!

speaker: Guard 1
en: What the devil is that?

speaker: Guard 2
en: Whiskey.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Well the whiskey here is terrible.

speaker: Guard 3
en: I miss my Marie. Such a true and fine heart is hard to find.

speaker: Guard 4
en: Where did you meet her?

speaker: Guard 3
en: At her third wedding. I slipped into the feast.

speaker: Guard 4
en: I would say you slipped into more than that!

speaker: Guard 5
en: I wonder why there are so many Royal Navy ships about.

speaker: Guard 6
en: I suppose because there are more French ships to challenge them.

speaker: Guard 5
en: Who has more ships, do you reckon?

speaker: Guard 6
en: The English, by far. But they're spread thin.

speaker: Guard 5
en: Do they have more than the Spanish?

speaker: Guard 6
en: Hard to tell. But the Spanish keep to the south. Too cold for them here.

speaker: Guard 5
en: I can't say I blame them.

speaker: Guard 7
en: Oh, by Beelzebub's balls, what happened to that wall? It looks like someone took a cannon to it.

speaker: Guard 8
en: I hate digging stone out of the frozen ground. Fixing it will take ages.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: So, Louis-Joseph, how goes the fur trade?

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Not well enough to put beef on my family's plates.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: If you want beef, raid more British brigs. They're loaded down with barrels!

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Oh yes, their Irish farms yield much meat, don't they? Oh that is smart management, far better than the locals could do.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Take a look at this. I "borrowed" these plans from a Royal Navy ship of the line. They are like nothing I have ever seen.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Good! We could use some more powerful weapons. Le Chasseur, allow me to present our associate, Shay Cormac.

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: Gentlemen, I have news... On this same ship I spied the Manuscript you seek. It was written in an exotic language I did not recognize and full of drawings. Plants and animals out of an opium dream.

speaker: Louis-Joseph
en: Were there no charts? No, no... no maps?

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: No. There may have been some kind of code, but neither I nor the Rosbifs could ken it.

speaker: Liam
en: Where is the Manuscript now?

speaker: Le Chasseur
en: The man who brought it said a man named Washington sent him.

speaker: Shay
en: I know that name, he's an important Templar isn't he?

speaker: Liam
en: He is, Lawrence Washington has great ambitions that Templars have helped fulfill. Shay, let's return and find him. You, sir, have our thanks.

speaker: Violet
en: Got it. Shay's in Paris alright. I even got a date for you. 1776.

speaker: Juhani
en: At this point in time, Franklin was the American ambassador to France.

speaker: Violet
en: Ladies and gentlemen, Mr. Otso Berg: Professional killer and amateur historian.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Arrêtes! (Stop!) What are you doing? I have no quarrel with you!

speaker: Criminal 1
en: You uncultured swine, you should not have left your backwater colony!

speaker: Criminal 2
en: Ouais, retourne à Boston! (Yeah, go back to Boston!)

speaker: Benjamin
en: Philadelphia, actually...

speaker: Criminal 1
en: Oh! So he's a comedian too?

speaker: Benjamin
en: Help! Help!

speaker: Benjamin
en: Shay, is that you? How long has it been? Er, where are my manners. Thank you, my friend, thank you! But... what are you doing in Paris?

speaker: Shay
en: With all due respect, sir, this is no time to talk. You're still in danger.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Yes, I... I must return to my family.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Ah, thank you, Shay. Please, wait for me. I just want to make sure my family is safe.

speaker: Benjamin
en: How... How did you do that? It was quite... fortunate.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck, Master Franklin. As I suspect you do.

speaker: Benjamin
en: Yes indeed, my good fellow. Yet, without your assistance today... Well, you have my thanks, Shay. Is there anything I can do for you? To repay you for this... er, kindness?

speaker: Shay
en: Actually, there is. I need to meet... a business acquaintance. I heard he would be at the Château de Versailles, two days from now.

speaker: Benjamin
en: And they don't just let anyone inside the royal palace. Very well. I'll see what can be arranged.

speaker: Shay
en: Stay my blade from the flesh of the innocent. Hide in plain sight. Never compromise the Assassin Brotherhood. These are the tenets of the Creed. The principles I used to live by. I was a young man then. The Seven Years' War was about to begin. I could not have imagined what the future had in store for me... Nor the cost I would choose to bear... My name is Shay Patrick Cormac. This is my story...

speaker: Shay
en: Admit it, I nearly had you!

speaker: Liam
en: Nearly counts for nothing, Shay. And besides, no... that was just luck.

speaker: Shay
en: I make my own luck, Liam.

speaker: Liam
en: Ah, you've been saying that for years, but you've precious little to show for it. Or have you been spending it all getting out of trouble?

speaker: Shay
en: Well you know, trouble just follows me around.

speaker: Liam
en: Let's head back. Come on! Captain de la Vérendrye and his crew must have run into some trouble. Who knew meeting with smugglers would lead to no good?

speaker: Shay
en: I still don't understand why you can't tell me what we're doing here.

speaker: Liam
en: Because Chevalier decided not to tell you.

speaker: Shay
en: I thought we were friends, Liam.

speaker: Liam
en: We are, but this is business. It doesn't concern you, Shay. Am I going too fast for you?

speaker: Shay
en: I'm just keeping my eye on you in case you fall down and hurt yourself.

speaker: Liam
en: Hurry! We best not keep Chevalier waiting.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Oh malédiction! Où sont ces crétin? (Shit! Where are those idiots?) Hold it together men! We will find a way off this island. Look to those wounds, young man.

speaker: Chevalier
en: ESPÈCE DE— (What the—) Where the hell were you two?

speaker: Shay
en: We were out hunting. What happened here?

speaker: Chevalier
en: My men were attacked by some English sea dogs!

speaker: Shay
en: Why Captain Joseph, couldn't you fight them all off by yourself like you're always saying?

speaker: Chevalier
en: It is Capitaine (Captain) Louis-Joseph Gaultier, Chevalier de la Vérendrye. And you are dreaming if you think any training could make you into a proper Assassin. Do you even know what that means? It means being responsible for an ancient and proud tradition. It means obeying your Mentor without question. How else will we ensure freedom for the human race?

speaker: Shay
en: Them's pretty words, Chevalier, but I don't feel too free at the moment.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Well then feel educated, urgh!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Viens, viens! (Come, Come!) I will teach you some manners, boy. How dare you show me such disrespect! You irresponsible wretch! You simpleton! You rot-brained cabbage farmer!

speaker: Liam
en: Gentlemen, stop! We've got a common enemy and I reckon he's close.

speaker: Chevalier
en: The Royal Navy attacked my vessel and forced my men to flee! We are stranded, and what is worse, the smugglers we were supposed to meet have been taken prisoner.

speaker: Liam
en: Shay and I will free those smugglers, you treat your wounded.

speaker: Liam
en: Take these, you'll need them. Tread with care, Shay. The Royal Navy will be ready for us. Remember your training.

speaker: Liam
en: Ready to teach them a lesson?

speaker: Shay
en: They don't stand a chance.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Where are your mates now, you bilge rat?

speaker: Shay
en: Not bad.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Talk before I bash out your brains! We will find them and let them bury what's left of you.

speaker: Smuggler 1
en: Thank you!

speaker: Guard 2
en: Keep an eye out, lads. Their pals are still out there somewhere.

speaker: Shay
en: There he goes again.

speaker: Smuggler
en: Many thanks, I thought I'd be hanged!

speaker: Guard 3
en: Happy hunting, lads!

speaker: Guard 4
en: Set her ablaze!

speaker: Guard 5
en: Sink that French vessel!

speaker: Guard 6
en: She's no match for you!

speaker: Shay
en: I was saving those fellows for you.

speaker: Liam
en: Very thoughtful.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Maybe you are not completely useless, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Speaking of useless, those blockheads won't be needing this vessel anymore.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Ce vieux ? (This tub?) This pile of merde? (shit?) You want her, Shay, she is yours. Now bring me back to my ship.

speaker: Liam
en: You heard Chevalier. This vessel is yours, Shay. Go on, take the wheel.

speaker: Liam
en: Some of the men you rescued agreed to join us. They should prove a good crew.

speaker: Chevalier
en: I am not so certain about their captain, but next to me you are the most experienced sailor in the Brotherhood, Shay. Besides, we could use another vessel, even this pitiful one.

speaker: Shay
en: She's mine, ain't she? My own ship.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Your own pile of garbage, yes.

speaker: Shay
en: Ah, with a lick of paint and a few new cannons, she'll look as fine as anything on the seven seas.

speaker: Liam
en: Shall we begin, Captain?

speaker: Shay
en: Indeed, Mate!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Abrutis... (Idiots...)

speaker: Shay
en: She's a mess, but she's still afloat. And her name's the Morrigan.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Morgane (Morrigan)... The silly fairy queen who ruined Merlin the Wise. Oh oh... she's perfect for you, Shay.

speaker: Liam
en: The Morrigan was an old goddess, she's the queen of War and Darkness. She harvested the souls of fallen warriors. Perfect indeed.

speaker: Chevalier
en: Oh mon Dieu! (My God!) My ship! Ces files de chiennes! (Those bastards!) They will sink her!

speaker: Liam
en: Let's put the Morrigan to the test, Captain Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Ready for battle, men!

speaker: Chevalier
en: Stop them, boy! They're tearing her to pieces! Do something! My ship!

speaker: Chevalier
en: It seems this vessel is battle-ready after all. I will return to what is left of Le Gerfaut. It is a long way home, and we have repairs to do.

speaker: Shay
en: Sing hearty, lads. Chevalier is pleased with us!

speaker: Liam
en: What course would you have me set, Shay?

speaker: Shay
en: Time to report back to the Mentor, wouldn't you agree?

speaker: Liam
en: Wise words, Captain. Wise words.

speaker: Shay
en: I've got the Precursor box. Smith's dead.

speaker: Liam
en: Well done, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Where's Chevalier?

speaker: Liam
en: Returning to Le Gerfaut. We'll have to celebrate without him, I'm afraid.

speaker: Shay
en: I don't feel much like celebrating, Liam... I know we have to get these artifacts back, but at what cost? Samuel Smith... He could barely hold his sword straight. Killing him was...

speaker: Liam
en: Necessary.

speaker: Shay
en: But

speaker: Liam
en: But nothing! Smith was a dangerous man, a Templar. And what's worse, he had the Precursor box. You should be proud of yourself, Shay.

speaker: Shay
en: Perhaps.

speaker: Liam
en: We should head for Albany now. James Wardrop, the fellow Lawrence Washington gave the Manuscript to, will be there. Kesegowaase reported that James Wardrop rooted out many tribes from their ancestral lands. We have proof that he's behind countless massacres. He's one of the most devious and ruthless men in the colonies. He uses the letter of the law to serve his purposes, and when the law does not bend to him, he gets lawmakers to bend it for him. Mark my words, Shay: James Wardrop is a bureaucrat, and doesn't care how his actions affect others.

speaker: Citizen 1
en: I have no business in Albany, sir, just visiting. My sister lives here.

speaker: Guard 1
en: And how long are you planning to stay?

speaker: Citizen 1
en: Only a few days.

speaker: Guard 1
en: Please wait here.

speaker: Citizen 1
en: So many soldiers posted here. Is all this to protect the politicians?

speaker: Guard 1
en: Indeed. There's more hot air here than in the .

speaker: Guard 2
en: Where are you from, sir?

speaker: Citizen 2
en: Trenton.

speaker: Guard 2
en: And what is your business here?

speaker: Citizen 2
en: That's none of your concern.

speaker: Guard 2
en: With respect, sir, it is.

speaker: Hope
en: You're here. The Congress is still in session. George Washington and his militia have French troops under Jumonville. The French are calling it an act of war.

speaker: Shay
en: George Washington. You mean Lawrence's younger brother?

speaker: Liam
en: Yeah, it's the same... Speaking of Lawrence Washington, since you eliminated him, James Wardrop has moved up in ranks. All the Templar resources are at his disposal now.

speaker: Shay
en: What about the Manuscript?

speaker: Hope
en: My sources in New York confirm that Wardrop has it. I also learned that he is here, at the Congress, under heavy guard.

speaker: Liam
en: Shay, find Wardrop, get that Manuscript.

speaker: Hope
en: This place is thick with Templar troops... Liam and I will make sure he doesn't escape.

speaker: Guard 3
en: I heard William Johnson was here.

speaker: Guard 4
en: Who's he?

speaker: Guard 3
en: Well, he's a trader and was Colonel of the Warriors of the Six Nations for a while. He's responsible for the New York levies now, I think. He also owns lands and trading posts all over the colonies. And he built Fort William Henry.

speaker: Guard 4
en: Never heard of him.

speaker: Guard 5
en: So what's so important about this Congress?

speaker: Guard 6
en: Who knows? They never tell us anything.

speaker: Citizen 3
en: My father is an old man. Can't you just

speaker: Guard 7
en: With respect, I cannot let just anyone inside.

speaker: Citizen 4
en: Where is your commanding officer? I want a word with him.

speaker: Guard 8
en: Let me just see if I can find him, sir.

speaker: Guard 9
en: I'm afraid not, ma'am.

speaker: Citizen 5
en: What about pie? Wouldn't you love some pie?

speaker: Citizen 6
en: What do you mean, I cannot attend the Congress?

speaker: Guard 9
en: I mean, you cannot attend, sir.

speaker: Citizen 6
en: I have money. And connections, you know.

speaker: Guard 9
en: That may be. But I can't let you in.

speaker: Citizen 6
en: Well, we'll see about that.

speaker: Citizen 7
en: We need closer ties with the Indians.

speaker: Citizen 8
en: I don't think we can trust them.

speaker: Citizen 9
en: Well, I don't think we have much choice. The French could attack at any time.

speaker: Citizen 7
en: They dare not, I hope.

speaker: Citizen 10
en: We should have our own king, right here in Albany.

speaker: Citizen 11
en: What about that young officer, Charles Lee? I hear he's got potential.

speaker: Citizen 10
en: Our own . I like it.

speaker: Shay
en: Ah... That must be the Templar William Johnson. Perhaps he has the Manuscript, or knows where it is.

speaker: Franklin
en: As I have stated previously, I believe we need a national union, granted by an act of Parliament but bringing greater independence to our colonies. The French are an immediate threat and we are ill-prepared to face them. To put it bluntly, the colonies must .

speaker: Johnson
en: A rousing speech, Master Franklin. But do you truly believe Great Britain will grant her colonies autonomy?

speaker: Franklin
en: They have little choice, Master Johnson. You know the remoteness of this frontier better than most.

speaker: Johnson
en: Yes... But let us leave politics for another day. I wanted to thank you for your research

speaker: Franklin
en: Of course, of course! In the brief time I could examine that box, I could tell it was something unique. From Ancient Egypt, you said? Well, as I mentioned in my letter, I am quite ready to electrify it...

speaker: Johnson
en: Excellent. We will have the box delivered shortly. As for the manuscript... Captain!

speaker: Captain
en: I apologize, sir, but Master Wardrop refused to hand it over. He said the risks were too great.

speaker: Johnson
en: The risks!? Ah... I apologize. You will have the manuscript and the box in the briefest of delays.

speaker: Johnson
en: You mangy excuse for a uniform! Run to Fort Frederick and tell Master Wardrop he had better cough up that manuscript post-haste! Else I will have him scalped!

speaker: Shay
en: I can't let that Lobster Captain reach Wardrop!

speaker: Shay
en: And now to Wardrop... and the Manuscript.

speaker: Wardrop
en: Look sharp, soldier! Soldier, mind that uniform! Well done, soldier. Do not stop on my behalf. Again, young man. We will make a soldier out of you.

speaker: Wardrop
en: Help! Men, we're under attack! That hooded man! Get him! The Templars will have their revenge! A whole battalion will be after you! You'll regret this, Assassin!

speaker: Shay
en: I'll take that, you Templar dog.

speaker: Wardrop
en: No! You have no idea what you are doing, fool.

speaker: Shay
en: Keeping the people free from your control.

speaker: Wardrop
en: How free will you be when the French undermine these squabbling colonies?

speaker: Shay
en: These colonies would be far better off without the Templars pulling the strings.

speaker: Wardrop
en: We bring order from chaos. If everything is permitted, no one is safe.

speaker: Shay
en: Even the devil can quote scripture to suit his own purposes.
